jobs.title: Safeguards Access Operations Specialist (hyrbrid, contract)
jobs.description:
Pay Rate: $120.00/hr

Office role;  This can be NY or SF or DC hubs with onsite being hybrid or flex.

Duration: Sep 29, 2026 – Mar 29, 2027. (4 openings.)

As a Safeguards Access Operations Specialist, you'll help run the programs that decide which organizations get access to Anthropic's most capable models and features, and keep that access appropriate over time. You'll review applications, provision and remove access, monitor participating organizations for misuse, and handle the communications that go with each decision. These programs are new, high-stakes, and evolving quickly, so the work rewards precision, sound judgment, and comfort applying detailed rules that change often.

Important context: this position may involve exposure to sensitive content, including material related to cybersecurity misuse and other high-risk domains.

Responsibilities: Review applications and eligibility for trusted and special access programs against established criteria, verifying organizational identity, stated use cases, and account history, with a documented rationale for each decision. Provision, suspend, and revoke access per program runbooks, keeping case records complete and current the same day. Monitor admitted organizations for policy violations, compromised credentials, and out-of-scope activity, escalating with supporting evidence. Process exemption and data-handling requests requiring manual review. Draft customer notices and coordinate with account teams on approvals, violations, and access changes. Work disputed or misclassified eligibility decisions, gathering context to support re-review. Flag gaps between written criteria and real cases, and suggest improvements to runbooks, checklists, and tooling. Provide surge review support during program launches/expansions and report on queue volume, turnaround, and outcomes.

• 2+ years in trust & safety, fraud, risk, compliance, or KYC/KYB (or another decision-against-written-policy ops role)
• Can hold many detailed, evolving program rules and apply them consistently
• Write clear decision rationales and customer-facing comms
• Keep meticulous, audit-ready records
• Know when to escalate and do so with a crisp summary; adapt quickly to new/revised processes
• Work well independently and cross-functionally with policy, enforcement, engineering, and sales
• Have genuine interest in AI safety.

Bonus:

jobs.title: Partner Engagement Manager, Federal Delivery Team
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

You will report to our Operations Manager for Federal Delivery. Your single most common task is to implement Onebrief at a new customer. Example:

 - A Federal Agency has just purchased a Onebrief license. Their headquarters and all of their Components will start planning in Onebrief. You will visit the headquarters routinely to make this happen.

 - The core planning team is excited about Onebrief, but there’s a lot of other planners and stakeholders who are skeptical. You need to win them over.

 - They’ve seen demos yet, but they’re not familiar with the product. You will need to train them.

 - If their first major planning event is a success, then they’re much more likely to succeed with Onebrief. You will make it a success.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

 - Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

 - Lead or support exercises.

 - Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

 - Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

 - When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

 - Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

 - Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven experience supporting operational planning, coordination, or execution within a complex Federal government environment, preferably at a large agency or headquarters organization.

 - Experience working across large Federal organizations and engaging stakeholders at multiple levels to drive alignment and execution.

 - Familiarity with Federal exercises, operational readiness activities, and the technical and security requirements associated with deploying software on classified government networks.

 - Proven ability to expand adoption and business presence within Federal customer organizations, particularly for software or technology solutions.

 - Experience providing high-touch customer support both in person and remotely, including coordinating incident resolution across customers, Product, and Engineering teams.

 - Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly master complex software, troubleshoot issues, and communicate technical concepts effectively to Federal customers.

 - Proven ability to navigate complex government organizations, build trusted relationships, overcome bureaucratic challenges, and drive measurable customer outcomes.

 - Current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and the ability to obtain and maintain access to Federal facilities.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

 - Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

 - You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

 - You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

 - You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

 - Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

 - Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

 - Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBVIO AI

Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar-powered, AI-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable—automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities.
Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our hardware team and help design the next generation of Obvio products.

You’ll work across the mechanical product-development cycle, from early concepts and CAD through prototyping, testing, DFM, and production. You’ll design components and assemblies that integrate cameras, electronics, sensors, and other hardware into products deployed in demanding outdoor environments.

This is an ideal role for an engineer early in their career who has a strong foundation in mechanical design and wants significant ownership of real, shipped hardware. You won’t just design parts in CAD - you’ll build prototypes, assemble and test your designs, work with manufacturing partners, troubleshoot problems, and iterate until products are ready to ship.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Mechanical design: Design components, enclosures, brackets, mounts, and assemblies for Obvio’s hardware products using 3D CAD.

 - Design for manufacturing: Develop parts for manufacturing processes including plastic injection molding, sheet metal forming and stamping, CNC machining, and other production methods.

 - Electromechanical integration: Design mechanical systems around cameras, PCBs, sensors, antennas, wiring, connectors, and other electronics.

 - Outdoor product design: Help develop robust hardware for long-term outdoor deployment, considering sealing, water and dust ingress, UV exposure, temperature, vibration, serviceability, and other real-world conditions.

 - Rapid prototyping: Build and iterate prototypes using 3D printing, CNC machining, off-the-shelf components, and other rapid fabrication methods.

 - Testing & iteration: Assemble prototypes, develop practical tests, identify mechanical failures or weaknesses, and rapidly improve designs based on what you learn.

 - Production drawings & tolerancing: Create clear engineering drawings, define appropriate tolerances, and ensure components can be manufactured and assembled reliably.

 - DFM/DFA: Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners to review designs, incorporate DFM feedback, improve manufacturability, and prepare components for production.

 - Material & process selection: Select appropriate materials, finishes, manufacturing processes, fasteners, seals, and other mechanical components based on product requirements.

 - Product ownership: Take ownership of components and subassemblies from initial requirements through design, prototype, validation, and production release.

 - Cross-functional development: Work closely with electrical, software, operations, and other engineering team members to turn product requirements into reliable physical products.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering field.

 - 2–5 years of professional mechanical engineering experience.

 - Strong 3D CAD skills and experience designing mechanical parts and assemblies.

 - Working knowledge of engineering drawings, dimensional tolerancing, tolerance stack-ups, and basic GD&T.

 - Understanding of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA).

 - Experience with one or more common production processes such as injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, stamping, or CNC machining.

 - Strong mechanical intuition and practical problem-solving ability.

 - Comfortable building, assembling, modifying, and testing your own designs.

 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve and engineers are expected to take ownership.

 - Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate directly with engineers, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience designing injection-molded plastic parts, including practical considerations such as wall thickness, draft, ribs, bosses, inserts, parting lines, and assembly features.

 - Experience designing formed or stamped sheet-metal components.

 - Experience with IP-rated, weather-resistant, or ruggedized products, including gaskets, seals, vents, cable entries, and enclosure design.

 - Experience designing products intended for continuous outdoor deployment.

 - Experience mechanically integrating cameras, optics, PCBs, sensors, antennas, connectors, or other electronics.

 - Hands-on experience with 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, or other rapid-prototyping tools.

 - Experience working directly with machine shops, injection molders, sheet-metal vendors, contract manufacturers, or tooling suppliers.

 - Experience developing products in a hardware startup, robotics, automotive, IoT, industrial equipment, security/camera systems, or another electromechanical product environment.

 - Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or another professional 3D CAD platform, with proficiency in parametric part and assembly design.


WHY THIS ROLE

 - Build products that matter. Your work will directly contribute to technology designed to reduce dangerous driving and improve road safety.

 - Ship real hardware. You’ll see your designs move from CAD and prototypes into production and deployment in the field.

 - Own meaningful engineering work. You’ll have substantial responsibility for components and designs without needing to wait years to get meaningful product ownership.

 - Work across the entire development cycle. Design, prototype, build, test, manufacture, deploy, learn, and improve.

 - Learn quickly. Work closely with an experienced hardware team while gaining exposure to mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and field engineering.

 - Move fast. We’re a Series A hardware startup where good ideas can become physical products quickly.

 - Competitive compensation and early-stage equity.




WHY OBVIO

 - Your work will help save lives and improve road safety

 - Series A of $22M led by Bain Capital 

 - Fast-moving startup environment with meaningful ownership

 - Competitive compensation and early-stage equity



Obvio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Obvio considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. Obvio is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Bat Specialist / Wildlife Biologist
jobs.description:
Thunder Rocks Federal is a tribally owned Small Business Administration (SBA)-certified 8(a) Small Disadvantaged Business and a subsidiary of Seneca Nation Group (SNG), the federal contracting arm of Seneca Holdings. SNG is Seneca Holdings' federal government contracting business that meets mission-critical needs of federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community customers. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs.  We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

Thunder Rocks Federal is seeking an experienced Bat Specialist/Wildlife Biologist to support federal natural resource management and environmental compliance programs. The successful candidate will conduct bat surveys, threatened and endangered species assessments, habitat evaluations, environmental compliance support, and technical reporting for federal clients.

This position requires extensive fieldwork, scientific analysis, and preparation of regulatory documentation supporting compliance with the Endangered Species Act (ESA), National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), Sikes Act, and other environmental regulations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Conduct bat inventory and monitoring surveys using accepted federal and state protocols.

• Perform mist-netting, harp trapping, acoustic monitoring, and emergence surveys.

• Identify bat species through visual assessment and acoustic data analysis.

• Conduct habitat assessments for federally listed, candidate, and sensitive species.

• Prepare technical reports, biological assessments, survey summaries, and environmental documentation.

• Support NEPA documentation, ESA consultations, and natural resource management planning.

• Coordinate with federal agencies, installation personnel, state wildlife agencies, and project stakeholders.

• Maintain detailed field notes and ensure quality assurance of biological data.

• Assist with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) mapping and spatial analysis.

• Support environmental permitting and compliance efforts.

• Travel frequently to project locations throughout the southeastern United States and other regions as required.

Required Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor's degree in:

• Wildlife Biology

• Conservation Biology

• Ecology

• Environmental Science

• Zoology

• Natural Resources Management

• Related biological science

Experience

• Minimum 3 years of experience conducting wildlife or natural resource surveys.

• Documented experience conducting bat surveys and species identification.

• Experience with threatened and endangered species programs.

• Experience preparing technical biological reports for federal or state agencies.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Wildlife Biology, Ecology, or related discipline.

• Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), NAVFAC, USACE, USFS, NPS, BLM, or other federal agencies.

• Demonstrated experience with:

• Indiana Bat surveys

• Northern Long-Eared Bat surveys

• Tricolored Bat surveys

• Gray Bat surveys

• Southeastern bat species monitoring

• Experience with acoustic analysis software such as Kaleidoscope, SonoBat, or Bat Call Identification.

• GIS proficiency using ArcGIS or ArcGIS Pro.

• NEPA and ESA compliance experience.

Required Certifications and Training

• Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.

• Current or previous federal/state bat handling authorization preferred.

• Ability to obtain installation access and pass federal background screening.

• Current CPR/First Aid certification preferred.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

• Ability to hike over uneven terrain, wetlands, forests, and remote locations.

• Ability to carry up to 40 pounds of field equipment.

• Ability to work extended hours, including night surveys and overnight travel.

• Ability to climb, bend, stoop, and navigate challenging field environments.

Technical Skills

• Wildlife survey methodologies

• Bat acoustic monitoring technology

• GPS data collection

• Scientific report writing

• Microsoft Office Suite

• ArcGIS/ArcGIS Pro

• Data management and quality control

Desired Competencies

• Strong scientific and analytical skills

• Excellent technical writing ability

• Independent decision-making capability

• Attention to detail

• Strong communication and client-facing skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

• Commitment to safety and environmental stewardship

Security Requirements

Candidate must be eligible to access Department of Defense facilities and successfully complete any required background checks.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Seneca Holdings provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, genetic information and/or predisposing genetic characteristics, victim of domestic violence status, veteran status, or other protected class status. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation and training. The Company also prohibits retaliation against any employee who exercises his or her rights under applicable anti-discrimination laws. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company does give hiring preference to Seneca or Native individuals. Veterans with expertise in these areas are highly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co http://Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co http://Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join Vibe's GTM Operations team — the group that owns the systems Sales, SDRs, CSMs, and AMs run on every day — reporting to the Director of GTM Operations. Salesforce is our source of truth for our Prospect and Customer data, account assignment, and pipeline management, and until now it's been maintained by an excellent team of distributed contractors. We're bringing it in house so the person who owns this infrastructure is embedded closely enough to understand what's riding on it. You'll own infrastructure the entire company depends on — a nine-person team touches it daily, but the data it produces powers every function downstream — work with the newest generation of AI tooling for CRM administration, and sit close enough to the business that your input shapes strategy rather than just executing it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the Salesforce instance

 - Administer Salesforce as the source of truth for account assignment and pipeline

 - Build and maintain the flows that power our funnel (assignment, routing, etc.)

 - Resolve data integrity issues before they reach a rep's workflow

Connect the GTM stack

 - Ensure that our integrations with Outreach/ Kaia, Default, and any other connected tool are functioning reliably

 - Build monitoring for data divergence between Salesforce and other internal systems

 - Surface sync failures, data hygiene issues, and operational issues proactively

Partner with the business

 - Translate requests from Sales, SDR, CSM, and AM teams into scalable system changes

 - Partner within the GTM Ops team on how data flows out from Salesforce into other internal tools

 - Apply AI to accelerate Salesforce build, testing, and documentation
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - Salesforce Administrator credentials, or equivalent hands-on depth in a production org

 - Experience building and maintaining Salesforce flows in a live revenue environment

 - Working competency with the Salesforce API

 - Experience connecting GTM tools — Outreach, Default, Calendly, Gong, or similar — into a CRM

 - Hands-on use of Claude or a comparable AI tool in your Salesforce work, with specific examples of what changed

 - Experience embedded on an in-house team, not exclusively client-side implementation work


NICE TO HAVES

 - Salesforce development skills without AI assistance — Apex, SOQL, custom build

 - Ability to read pipeline and GTM metrics well enough to pressure-test an incoming request

 - Experience building data quality monitoring or observability for a CRM
   
   


OUR VALUES

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.




WHAT WE OFFER

For candidates in New York, the base salary range for this role is $150,000-$200,000, plus variable.



At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

 - Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

 - Full health coverage — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k) with matching — We invest in your future, not just your output.

 - Flex PTO — Take the time you need. We measure results, not hours.

 - Workspace worth showing up for — Our Flatiron office is full of natural light, we're in 4 days a week with flexibility built in, and our amazing workplace experiences manager keeps the space.

 - Parental leave — Paid leave for all parents.

 - Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.
   
   


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

 1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

 2. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

 3. Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

 4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

 5. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.
    
    


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Department Manager - Sawgrass Mills
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By bringing everyone together, you’ll be able to create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, helping you, your team, and H&M succeed. Ensuring an excellent operational & visual experience for your store, customers & colleagues. You’ll be aware of your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. Analyze and follow up on sales, and create plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them
• Establish & analyze sales and budget goals, creating plans to optimize results
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Manage your department in a cost-efficient way
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions

Team & Development

• Responsible for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, upskilling & developing your team in-store
• Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business & team needs
• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
• Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding & introduction processes, trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
• Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
• Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
• Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
• Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

• To be a successful and effective Department Manager, you’ll be a strong leader who enjoys taking responsibility for others.
• You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
• You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $23.56 - $27.09 hourly**

EEOC Code: SLS

Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Director, Finance - Services
jobs.description:
The Nuclear Company is the fastest growing AI tech-enabled startup in the nuclear and energy space, pioneering a fleet-scale approach to building the next generation of nuclear reactors. Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy.

We operate with an AI-first mindset. Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence.

We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values—Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity—guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. TRUST is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission.

About the role

TNC is scaling its Services segment through a buy-and-build acquisition strategy layered on a growing organic field and professional services book. The Director of Finance, Services is the segment finance lead for Services, owning planning, forecasting, contract economics, and deal support for the segment. Accounting and controllership are centralized under the CAO; this role owns everything forward-looking for Services.

Role is embedded with the Services organization as the day-to-day finance partner to segment operating leaders, while reporting to the VP, Nuclear Finance, preserving a clean group finance line. Builds and leads the Services finance team so the segment can absorb acquisitions without losing forecast accuracy or reporting discipline. Success depends on operating fluently across two worlds...

1) the operational, field-driven rhythm of a labor-intensive services business, working closely with P&L owners on jobs, crews, and customers, and

2) group planning and reporting, partnering tightly with the VP, Nuclear Finance, the Controller's team, and Corporate FP&A so Services plugs cleanly into corporate processes.

Responsibilities

Business partnership & P&L leadership

• Primary day-to-day finance partner to Services operating leaders and P&L owners; own the financial narrative behind the Services P&L

• Bring financial rigor and challenge to the business; help shape pricing, rate cards, bidding, and margin decisions

• Deliver decision-quality analysis on job profitability, unit economics, labor utilization, backlog, and working capital

• Run the monthly operating review rhythm with Services leadership

FP&A and planning

• Own the Services annual operating plan, rolling forecast, and long-range plan, integrating acquired businesses into a single segment operating model that rolls up cleanly to the group plan

• Establish and track the KPIs that matter for the segment: job margin, utilization, backlog-to-bill, DSO and working capital

• Maintain forecast accuracy standards for executive and board reporting

Contract economics & classification

• Own segment and line-of-business classification at contract inception, working the revenue checklist with the Controller's team so every new contract lands where it belongs on day one

• Keep rate cards current and defensible, including for related-party engagements, and give every material bid a finance view before it goes out

Deal finance & M&A

• Support deal finance for the Services acquisition program: financial diligence, deal models, and integration planning through post-close performance tracking

• Partner with Corporate Development and the CAO organization on opening balance sheets and post-acquisition true-ups

• Hold acquired businesses accountable to the financial premise underlying each deal

Executive reporting

• Deliver segment-grade Services reporting aligned to how the company presents its operating segments

• Prepare Services content for board and executive leadership reviews

Systems, AI & scalability

• Build and deploy AI tools and agentic workflows across Services planning, forecasting, and reporting; scale the function through AI rather than headcount

• Partner on standardizing acquired businesses onto TNC's ERP and finance systems

Team & organization building

• Hire, develop, and lead the Services finance managers, building bench strength beneath the director seat

• Establish a finance operating model that absorbs acquisitions without proportional headcount growth

Experience

• 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including FP&A leadership and operating or segment finance ownership

• Working command of ASC 606 for service contracts: time and materials, cost plus, and fixed price

• Experience partnering directly with operational P&L owners and translating operating strategy into financial outcomes

• Demonstrated M&A finance exposure: diligence, deal models, or integration

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

Preferred Experience

• CPA and/or MBA

• Field services, nuclear, utilities, or industrial services experience; comfort with craft labor economics (utilization, per diems, pass-through costs)

• Track record of value creation in an acquisitive (buy-and-build) environment

• NetSuite or comparable ERP fluency

• Hands-on experience deploying AI and automation in core finance processes

Benefits

• Competitive compensation packages

• 401k with company match

• Medical, dental, vision plans

• Generous vacation policy, plus holidays

The estimated starting salary range for this role is $178,000 - $204,000 annually less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi-weekly basis. The actual salary offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined in the Company’s discretion, which may include experience, qualifications, tenure, skill set, availability of qualified candidates, geographic location, certifications held, and other criteria deemed pertinent to the particular role.

• Responsible for safely transporting patient oxygen after being set up by clinician.
• Provides feedback to management regarding equipment conditions and availability.
• Other duties as assigned.

• BLS through American Heart Association (or within 90 days of employment)

jobs.title: 21GRAMS- New Business Lead
jobs.location: Boston - Massachusetts; Carmel - Indiana; Chicago - Illinois; Lambertville - New Jersey; North Carolina; Remote - USA; United States
jobs.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a New Business Lead to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry seeks an accomplished and strategically minded Head of New Business to lead the agency’s growth function and drive best-in-class business development for 21GRAMS. In this role, you will establish and refine new business processes, develop a high-performing growth team, and serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior leadership, directly impacting pipeline development, win rates, and revenue growth.

This position is integral to 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, a healthcare advertising and communications firm dedicated to making healthcare more human through innovative, client-centered work conducted with integrity and excellence. You will lead all aspects of new business development, from opportunity identification through pitch execution. You will ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized experience, fostering collaboration, efficiency and confidence at every stage.

Additionally, you will help own the new client onboarding process, ensuring that day-to-day brand teams are fully equipped with the insights, timelines, and resources needed to service each brand from day one. This critical handoff function bridges the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work, setting the foundation for long-term client partnerships.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

New Business Process Development

• Establish, refine, and enforce new business processes and standards across the agency

• Create repeatable frameworks for how opportunities are evaluated, pursued, and executed

Growth Team Leadership

• Lead and develop a high-performing new business team

• Ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized, and collaborative experience

Pipeline Management

• Identify and qualify new business opportunities

• Manage the full pipeline from initial opportunity through close

• Track and report on win rates, pipeline health, Saleforce integration, and revenue impact

Pitch Leadership

• Lead and support pitch efforts across the agency and with Real Chemistry Partners

• Coordinate cross-functional teams through the pitch process

• Foster confidence and collaboration at every stage of the pursuit

Strategic Partnership with Senior Leadership

• Serve as a trusted strategic partner to agency leadership on all growth matters

• Inform and influence go-to-market strategy across therapeutic areas including launch planning

New Client Onboarding

• Help own the end-to-end onboarding process for all newly won clients

• Ensure day-to-day account teams are fully equipped with the insights, context, and resources needed to service each brand from day one

• Bridge the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

• Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.

• You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.

• You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.

• You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.

• You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

• Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution

• 12+ years of new business, account management, or project management experience in a healthcare advertising setting

• Minimum 5+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity managing high-performing, cross-functional teams in high-pressure environments

• Demonstrated expertise in pharmaceutical advertising, healthcare communications, or life sciences agency environment with hands-on experience managing teams and new business opportunities

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical promotion standards, FDA/OPDP guidance, and healthcare communications

• Demonstrated ability in data analysis, reporting, and translating metrics into actionable business insights

• Working knowledge of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid approaches, with ability to select appropriate methodology for each pitch opportunity

• Proven track record of leading, developing, and motivating teams to high performance

• Executive-level communication skills—ability to present complex information clearly to C-suite audiences, stakeholders, and clients

• Strong written and verbal communication with ability to adapt messages for diverse audiences

• Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, make decisions under uncertainty, and balance competing priorities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Deep expertise in pharmaceutical advertising and healthcare communications, particularly with experience in oncology, rare disease, specialty pharmaceuticals, or other complex therapeutic areas

• Demonstrated results from process improvement initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency gains, cost reduction, or quality improvement

• Client relationship management experience at a senior level, including presenting to pharmaceutical and biotech executives

CORE COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES

Professional Competencies

• Strategic Business Leadership: Setting vision and direction; aligning operations with business objectives; thinking beyond immediate execution to organizational capability building

• Process Excellence: Designing, implementing, and continuously improving standardized processes and workflows that scale across new business

• Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining effective relationships with executives, clients, cross-functional partners, and team members; navigating competing interests

• Organizational Development: Building high-performing teams, developing talent, creating culture, and leading organizational change

Required Leadership Attributes

• Change-Positive, Growth-Oriented

You actively seek smarter, faster, and more effective ways to operate. You are not threatened by AI, innovation, new tools, or new ways of working—you're energized by them. You challenge legacy thinking thoughtfully, experiment with confidence, and view change as an advantage rather than a disruption. You don't defend the status quo because "it works"; you see every process, system, and methodology as a candidate for improvement. You are quick to spot opportunities to expand how we operate collectively and you bring others along on that journey. You stay current with emerging PM tools and methodologies because you're genuinely curious about better ways forward, not because compliance requires it.

• Commercially and Market Aware

You operate beyond internal agency mechanics and understand the bigger picture. You know your clients' business contexts, therapeutic landscapes, and commercial realities well enough to make informed decisions, ask smarter questions, and connect execution to real-world impact. You don't need to be a medical expert, but you are an industry-savvy operator who understands pharma economics, launch timelines, competitive dynamics, and patient access challenges. You ask "why does this matter commercially?" and "what does success look like for the client?" regularly. This commercial acumen informs how you scope projects, allocate resources, and prioritize decisions. You help your team see beyond deliverables to outcomes.

• Confident Driver of Progress

You embrace being a driver, not just a facilitator or administrator. You create momentum, push for clarity and decisions when you see ambiguity, hold teams accountable constructively without micromanaging, and move work forward even when information is imperfect or circumstances are complicated. You don't wait for consensus to take action; you make smart calls and bring people along. You recognize that indecision is a decision, and you're willing to take that on. You drive toward clear wins and celebrate progress, which energizes your teams and builds confidence across the organization.

• Steward of Team Balance and Performance

You actively shape the health of the system, not just the output. You recognize burnout early—in individuals and in teams—and you recalibrate workload, expectations, or resources proactively before people break. You also recognize underperformance with equal clarity and you raise the bar constructively, providing support and accountability. You design operating rhythms, sprint cycles, and governance structures that support both sustainable, high performance and uncompromising standards. You understand that how people feel about their work is as important as what they produce, and that sustainable excellence requires both.

• Ownership Mindset and Creative Agency

You do not wait for permission to elevate the work. You bring forward ideas on how to operate better, propose smarter ways of organizing projects, design stronger plans, and take responsibility for improving outcomes beyond your assigned scope. You see gaps and fill them. You spot inefficiencies and fix them. You don't assume "that's someone else's problem"—you own the enterprise. This doesn't mean doing everything yourself; it means taking initiative to identify what needs to change and driving toward solutions. Your ownership extends to your team's success, your clients' outcomes, and the health of the broader organization.

• Strong Judgment and Prioritization Instincts

You consistently make good calls under pressure and constraint. You distinguish signal from noise in a sea of competing demands. You make smart trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk with sound instinct—not by formula. You prioritize effectively, recognizing what matters most and what can wait. You have good instincts about people, situations, and strategic priorities, and you trust those instincts while remaining open to new information. When you have to move fast, you do. When you need to be deliberate, you are. You know the difference, and you rarely get it wrong.

• Courage and Comfort with Productive Discomfort

You are willing to push when it's uncomfortable and challenge constructively when you see a better path. You hold tension without smoothing it away prematurely; you recognize that some of the best solutions come from sitting with uncomfortable questions rather than resolving them quickly. You make difficult calls when needed—hard conversations, tough decisions, unpopular stands—with confidence rather than approval-seeking. You bring backup (data, reasoning, alternatives) to every discussion. You operate with the confidence of someone who takes responsibility for their decisions and is willing to defend them, but you're also genuinely open to being wrong and course-correcting when new information warrants it.

Pay Range: $250,000-$290,000
The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser - Tanger Outlets at National Harbor
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Visual Merchandiser, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
• Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
• Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
• Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
• Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
• Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
• Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
• Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, products, brands, competitors, and relevant influencers etc.
• Plan time for fashion & trend awareness to understand trend theory and mood boards for styling techniques and product presentation to anticipate our customer’s needs and enhance our shopping experience in store

Team & Development

• Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
• Coach and develop the Store team´s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
• Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
• Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues
• Organize, provide, and carry out the visual & commercial upskilling for you and your colleagues
• Complete Visual Competencies & Commercial 4 All trainings based on Regional & Sales Market learning and development goals
• Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

• Execute the visual & commercial curation & styling for the store based on commercial calendar, allocation, store activation plan and fashion trends according to mood boards and direction from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Carry out sample picking best practice routines including stockroom garment quantities, accessories, and shoes to ensure you create clear trends and stories according to inspiration from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Secure window & styling execution according to visual & commercial guidelines to create inspirational and commercial customer experience
• Provide good customer flow by maintaining commercial layout, fixtures, to secure the best trend story placement
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in windows and throughout the store following guidelines according to Global strategy and Sales Market requirements
• In collaboration with Facilities Management ensure all lighting is working correctly, aimed to highlight our products and display forms in windows and throughout the store
• Maintain and care for all display forms and interior material (fixtures & fittings) with sustainability in mind
• In collaboration with Area Visual Manager ensure your store navigation is maintained and kept up to date according to latest guidelines and store layout
• Ensure your store has enough quantities of sale and other activity including POS material according to local routines
• Keep sales floor and back of house clean, organized, and safe according to local security guidelines

Who You Are

• For you to be a successful Visual Merchandiser, you must be curious and creative; always looking for inspiration, proactive, solution focused, flexible, with effective communication skills to achieve results cross functionally.
• We look for individuals with fashion interests and leadership skills who can apply their visual and commercial experience working in a dynamic environment to the role.
• Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
• Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
• Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
