jobs.title: Provider Recruiter (Temporary Assignment)
jobs.description:
About Hopscotch Primary Care

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we believe great healthcare should be accessible to all people across all communities.  Today, almost 20% of Americans live in a rural community, yet only 11% of physicians practice in those same communities.  We are on a mission to transform healthcare in rural America.  We provide high-quality primary care tailored to meet the needs of our patients through our robust care model and comprehensive care team, delivering care in our clinics, and across settings, and wrapping resources around the patients who need them most.

Our patients and the care teams who serve them sit at the center of everything we do at Hopscotch.  Hopscotch Primary Care takes a team approach to serve patient needs and provide the best care possible.  Our goal is to provide the care each of us would want for ourselves or for our family members, in the right setting, and at the right time.

Today, we are serving thousands of patients in our value-based care model and the number is growing every day.  If you want to bring your experience, skill and passion to make a lasting impact in healthcare, we’d like to meet you.

About the Role

Hopscotch Health has an immediate temporary opening for an experienced, mission-driven, Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. Working closely with operations and clinical team leaders, your primary responsibility is hiring for advanced practice provider, physician and medical director team members. You will also serve as the recruiting subject matter expert, consulting with hiring managers and other company stakeholders to navigate the complexities of the recruiting process.

This role is remote-based but may require local travel to clinic-level markets, conferences, meetings, and events as needed. Preference for candidates located in Western North Carolina.

What You'll Do

• Develop and execute creative and impactful strategies to identify, source and attract high quality Physician and Advanced Practice Provider candidates.

• Convey the Hopscotch mission with passion and conviction to attract and retain top talent

• Manage an assigned req load and execute recruitment process and life-cycle from start to finish to include applicant sourcing, resume review, phone screens, coordinating interviews, negotiations, and offers

• Act as a consultant to multiple partners regarding recruitment, sourcing, staffing forecasting, talent planning, diversity and internal movement

• Work in partnership with a variety of internal partners, hiring managers and external vendors to meet Hopscotch’s talent needs

• Develop comprehensive sourcing strategies and conduct candidate sourcing for assigned roles by leveraging multiple sourcing channels to identify and attract top talent

• Provide best-in-class recruitment experience for your candidates and assigned internal partners throughout the hiring process

• Participate in recruitment events as needed.

• Partner with Human Resources, Credentialing, IT, and other internal stakeholders on employee onboarding to ensure effective and seamless process

• Meet defined recruiting metrics and KPIs including quality, cost, cycle time, etc.

• Participate in special projects as required; including support for other staffing needs

About You

• 5+ years of experience as an exceptional, full-cycle provider recruiter in a high-growth, fast paced healthcare setting

• Experience in primary care, family practice and internal medicine settings;

• Knowledge of value-based care is a plus.

• Proven proficiency in developing creative and effective physician and advanced sourcing strategies utilizing multiple channels

• Proven success in developing, communicating, and presenting a compelling employer brand to attract top candidates in a market or field where need outpaces available talent

• Deep knowledge of ATS systems: posting open requisitions, tracking candidate activity, and maintaining 100% compliance with required data fields

• Greenhouse ATS knowledge preferred but not required.

• Well-developed team skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience, confidence, and presence to effectively handle interpersonal relationships and sensitive HR issues

From a cultural perspective, you:

• Create a culture of excellence, by bringing your best and encouraging the same from those around you

• Put service to patients first and encourage the same of those around you

• Take ownership and accountability for your work and for delivering results for patients

• Assume the best in others and bring solutions to challenges with a focus on moving forward together

• Show an active commitment to the team by collaborating and communicating proactively

• Demonstrate a dedication to continuous improvement, in clinical and cultural settings

In accordance with the Illinois Pay Transparency Act, we’re providing the full salary range for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on location, relevant experience and qualifications. Most offers will fall within a portion of the listed range. This position has a salary range of $85,000 – $100,000 annually, based on location, relevant experience and qualifications.

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we embrace diversity, invest in a culture of inclusion and positivity and encourage all to apply to join our team.  You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: High School: Precalculus Lead Teacher - Greater Boston (2026-2027)
jobs.description:
Lead Teacher at KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School

KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School is looking for talented, committed, and culturally competent lead teachers who have the power to amplify our children’s potential by creating a school experience that affirms, values, and challenges students each day. We seek to create a professional and authentic environment of joy, excellence, care, and community where educators can make long-term transformative outcomes for students.

This role requires consistent and reliable demonstration of the following essential job functions and key responsibilities:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Classroom Responsibilities

• Serve as a lead or co-lead in a classroom (or classrooms), with responsibilities that may include: leading a class independently, co-teaching, short- or long-term coverage, or stepping into a lead classroom role later in the year based on the school's needs.
• Ensure that all children are affirmed, valued, and challenged every day
• Foster a positive and safe learning environment
• Prepare and internalize rigorous and engaging unit and daily lessons, leveraging provided curricula/resources and intellectual preparation tools
• When applicable, may be asked to create and internalize academically aligned lesson plans, unit plans, rubrics, and assessments
• Set specific, ambitious growth goals with all students and identify and leverage all necessary resources to ensure they meet them
• Innovate on best practices to execute engaging, differentiated instruction at a level rigorous for all students
• Implement aligned school-wide or grade-level student culture systems and proactive classroom management strategies
• Regularly analyze student work and academic data to modify lessons, refine curricula, and inform instructional practice
• Maintain accurate, up-to-date student grades/records and initiate strong lines of communication with students and their families regularly regarding students’ growth and progress

School and Professional Responsibilities

• Obtain required MTEL and SEI endorsements with financial support from KIPP MA within the first year of employment in addition to free study support (please review this doc to see requirements)
• Participate in school-wide and individual professional development, including pre-service training over the summer and weekly during the academic year
• Take ownership for the development of your craft seeking and implementing feedback from your coach and collaborating with teammates within and beyond school-designed structures
• Perform assigned duties including (but not limited to) classroom coverage, bus, lunch, transition, and dismissal duties
• Develop strong relationships with families through participation in school events and consistent phone calls, texts, and/or emails with caregivers
• Be willing to offer support and receive constructive feedback from colleagues in order to create a professional working atmosphere that is conducive to accountability, change, and improvement
• Collaborate with grade level and content teams to tackle common challenges and implement grade-wide systems, sharing responsibility for all students
• Dependable attendance according to our school calendar, initiating proactive communication when attendance barriers arise

General Requirements and Responsibilities

• Embody KIPP MA’s Code of Conduct by acting with integrity, leading with humanity, centering self-awareness and critical consciousness, taking personal responsibility, and engaging productively
• Participate and engage in regional professional development and community events as required
• Demonstrated ability to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and make reasonable judgments and decisions in a timely manner in accordance with the needs of the school
• Self-awareness, flexibility and emotional intelligence to navigate a setting with students who express diverse needs
• The consistent use of interpersonal and self-management skills to effectively support behavioral and emotional needs of students to ensure a safe and inclusive environment, as well as build relationships and manage conflict with students, staff, and caregivers
• Effective communication skills to perform assigned duties and to meaningfully exchange information with students, staff, families and others in person, through written communication, in front of groups, and on virtual platforms
• Physical mobility to move self in various positions in order to execute duties effectively, which may include kneeling, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, twisting, turning, bending, stooping and reaching overhead
• Physical strength sufficient to periodically lift and/or carry 20 pounds of materials or supplies and to physically restrain a student to keep from harming themself and/or others in an emergency situation
• Manual dexterity sufficient to perform repetitive hand/wrist/arm motions and to operate a computer and office equipment

KIPP MA teachers are supported in their demanding work by experienced and dedicated leadership and staff who have themselves proven successful in the teaching role. Our leaders maintain consistent school-wide systems and procedures - academic, behavioral, cultural, logistical - designed to permit teachers to do their best work.

In addition to the responsibilities listed above, there will occasionally be other duties as assigned that teachers will engage in to help promote a positive and calm learning environment and culture.

• Deep alignment with KIPP MA’s mission and values, including the unwavering belief in the high potential of all students

• Demonstrated ability to drive student growth and achievement and to create a warm, inclusive, rigorous learning environment
• Passion for subject/content area and demonstrated commitment to professional learning
• 2+ years of full-time teaching experience
• Bachelor’s Degree required
• Pass Criminal Background Check

KIPP MA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in building a vibrant and welcoming school community that advances our mission of ensuring that all KIPP students graduate with the skills and confidence to lead fulfilling lives. This includes a commitment to attracting and developing individuals who understand the experiences of the students and communities we serve. We hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

The minimum base salary for this exempt position is $55,000 to $89,500 (per 1.0 FTE/45 hours per week), depending upon years of relevant experience after your Bachelor's degree and any advanced degrees (+$3,000 for 1st advanced degree and +$1,500 for 2nd advanced degree). The role includes a $1,000 signing bonus—and an annual $2,000 retention bonus in subsequent years, as well as other bonuses, when eligible. This role follows our School Year calendar. For more about what we offer, how to apply and more about KIPP MA, please visit this link HERE.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Our Project Managers are responsible for planning, executing and overseeing projects from inception to completion, ensuring that objectives are met on time, within agreed scope and budget, and to the required quality.

Working within a structured framework, Project Managers make key decisions that support project success, provide clear direction to teams and maintain accountability. They regularly engage with team members, users, customers and stakeholders to ensure requirements remain aligned with user needs and project goals.

Beyond task management, Project Managers act as crucial points of communication, fostering collaboration among stakeholders, sponsors and cross-functional teams. They manage expectations, facilitate engagement and create positive partnerships that support successful delivery.

The Project Manager maintains the overall integrity and coherence of the project, coordinating the workstreams, milestones, dependencies, risks and governance required to deliver the agreed outcome.

Job objective

Our Project Managers are responsible for planning, executing and overseeing projects from inception to completion, ensuring that objectives are met on time, within agreed scope and budget, and to the required quality.

Working within a structured framework, Project Managers make key decisions that support project success, provide clear direction to teams and maintain accountability. They regularly engage with team members, users, customers and stakeholders to ensure requirements remain aligned with user needs and project goals.

Beyond task management, Project Managers act as crucial points of communication, fostering collaboration among stakeholders, sponsors and cross-functional teams. They manage expectations, facilitate engagement and create positive partnerships that support successful delivery.

The Project Manager maintains the overall integrity and coherence of the project, coordinating the workstreams, milestones, dependencies, risks and governance required to deliver the agreed outcome.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership & autonomy

• Works under general direction within a clear framework of accountability.

• Exercises personal responsibility and autonomy.

• Influences customers, suppliers and partners and develops strong relationships at all levels within the business.

• May have responsibility for the work of others and for the allocation or coordination of resources.

• Participates in external activities related to own specialism where appropriate.

• Makes decisions which influence the success of projects and team objectives.

• Collaborates regularly with team members, users and customers and engages to ensure that user needs are met throughout delivery.

• Provides clear direction across project workstreams and raises resource or delivery concerns through the agreed governance route.

• Prepares training materials for internal PMO and business-wide use where required.

• Lives NIQ’s values: Client obsessed; Driven to win; Accountable for results, Committed to integrity, Fast to adapt.

Stakeholder management and communication

• Is a flexible and effective stakeholder manager, working to motivate, negotiate, mediate and direct to ensure positive project outcomes.

• Creates and maintains positive engagement with project sponsors and customers.

• Facilitates collaboration between stakeholders who share common objectives.

• Develops close and effective partnerships with specialist teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Clarifies roles, responsibilities, dependencies and expected contributions across the project.

• Develops and maintains appropriate project status, progress and project-health reporting.

• Maintains a proportionate communications plan covering who needs to know what, when and in what format.

• Supports client communication needs and works effectively with senior stakeholders and client counterparts.

Project & change management

• Investigates, defines and resolves complex issues.

• Defines, documents and carries out projects or sub-projects, alone or with a small team, actively participating in all phases.

• Agrees the project approach with stakeholders and supports the definition and sign-off of the Statement of Work or equivalent project documentation.

• Prepares realistic integrated plans covering milestones, activities, owners, dependencies, quality, risk and communications, and tracks delivery against the project schedule.

• Uses an appropriate rolling-wave view to give stakeholders clarity on upcoming activity, decisions and dependencies.

• Identifies, assesses and manages risks to project success and owns the issue log, ensuring actions and escalation routes are clear.

• Manages dependencies among teams and monitors the critical path, taking action where delivery is at risk.

• Monitors costs, timescales, scope, quality and resources used and takes action where these deviate from agreed tolerances.

• Implements a proportionate change-control process, assesses the impact of proposed changes and communicates approved changes.

• Escalates potential PID, scope or plan changes at the appropriate time and obtains approval through agreed governance.

• Implements appropriate project governance, including repositories, standard forms, artefacts, meetings and decision forums.

• Ensures that projects are formally closed and, where appropriate, subsequently reviewed, with lessons learned recorded.

Business knowledge

• Has a thorough understanding of relevant industry and specialist project-management bodies of knowledge.

• Independently works to gain a thorough knowledge of the organisation and the business domain surrounding the project.

• Applies knowledge effectively in unfamiliar situations, rapidly absorbs new information and uses it to support delivery decisions.

• Understands how project choices may affect users, clients, operational outcomes, costs and delivery viability.

• Actively maintains own knowledge, contributes to the development of others and takes responsibility for driving own development.

• Maintains awareness of developing practices and their application.

• Gathers feedback on PMO processes and generates ideas for process improvement.

• Contributes to the definition, implementation and communication of beneficial changes to PMO processes.

• 4 years minimum of Project Management experience, or equivalent experience in business process improvement, operations, team leadership or client service.
• The candidate should have experience working with online project management tools such as Smartsheet, Monday.com, and Microsoft Project Online.
• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and delivering agreed results.
• Strong written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.

• Ability to work effectively with senior leaders, clients and specialist stakeholders.

• Experience with project-management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet or Jira is advantageous.

• Accredited Project Management certification is advantageous.

• Client-facing experience and experience in Retail, CPG or FMCG are advantageous.

• Fluent written and spoken English; flexibility to work across stakeholder time zones where required.

Our Benefits

• Flexible working environment
• Volunteer time off
• LinkedIn Learning
• Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Job Summary

Voyager wants you to be a critical contributor in the Mojave office to advance the development of propulsion systems for Voyager’s sub-orbital VTVL vehicles. You will be responsible for working directly on all aspects of the propulsion systems, from initial component and system sizing through design, analysis, fabrication, and test. You will regularly report to the Propulsion Lead on progress, as part of a joint propulsion team collaborating with the Pittsburgh office.

Job Responsibilities:

• Support the engineering team in the design and test of rocket propulsion systems

• Size components of propulsion systems including turbomachinery, combustion devices, valves, propellant feed systems, tanks, and pressurization systems.

• Perform trade studies using propulsion system fluid-thermal models to inform design and operations.

• Create solid models of propulsion components for use in modeling or hardware fabrication.

• Create component specifications to guide vendor interactions and support procurement

• Develop test plans, execute tests, and post-process results for component and system testing.

• Support testing operations for rocket engines and components

• Write technical reports and present to technical teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• B.S. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or similar

• Experience (2+ years) in propulsion system design, analysis, manufacture, integration, and/or test

• Familiar with fluid/thermal design and analysis using system level modeling tools (GFSSP, Amesim, Thermal Desktop or similar)

• Familiar with solid modeling (Solidworks preferred)

• Experience designing or specifying components for fluid systems

• Teamwork and collaboration while multi-tasking in a small team

• Ability to self-start with minimal guidance

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

• M.S. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering

• Experience with cryogenic propulsion systems (liquid oxygen and liquid methane preferred)

• Experience leveraging additive manufacturing in engine design

• Analytical/scientific programming (Python, C/C++, Matlab)

• Hands-on fabrication skills and a willingness to be hands-on with pathfinder hardware

• Rocket test facility design, integration, and/or operation

• Computational Fluid Dynamics (Ansys FLUENT preferred), including conjugate heat transfer

• Rocket fuel handling equipment and operations

• Experience with rocket turbopumps

This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Relocation assistance is provided for qualified candidates moving to Mojave, CA.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Risk & Logistics Policy Analyst (Senior Consultant)
jobs.description:
You understand the power of great service experience and its ability to inspire customer behavior.  You have a keen understanding of what it takes to deliver exceptional services, both in front of the house and behind the scenes.  But most of all, you see all of this in the context of furthering our clients’ core mission or business. You will help large, complex government organizations, especially the Department of Defense, to transform the way they use information to improve operations. The issues to be resolved are often difficult to define and quantify; may involve complex, traditionally competing interests; are often characterized by senior leadership interest and visibility and require extensive proving and analysis.

Technical Assent is seeking a Department of Defense / Department of War policy analyst to support the development of DoW-level policy documents concerning Commercial Support to Operations (CSO) and/or Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM). The Office of the Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Logistics is responsible for accelerating the adoption of CSO and SCRM standards and guidance across the Department, sharing identified supply chain or vendor risks, advancing the use of enterprise analytics, tools, and data, and establishing processes for elevating enterprise-wide risks to senior DoD leaders. The project provides expertise in supply chain risk management, logistics strategy and policy, supply chain operations, and asset management. The team supports the full lifecycle of defense-wide logistics and SCRM policies, monitors sustainment programs, and strengthens visibility, accountability, resilience, and auditability across critical defense supply chains and assets. This project focuses on the comprehensive modernization, systematic tracking, and cross-functional synchronization of all active logistics and supply chain risk policies, instructions, and directives maintained by the office. By implementing rigorous administrative controls, strong records management, risk tracking, and proactive stakeholder coordination, this effort ensures all logistics and SCRM guidance remains accurate, compliant, responsive to evolving threats, and aligned with modern warfighting requirements.

Role Description

The Senior Consultant will support Department-wide supply chain risk management (SCRM) across logistics and supply chain equities, including acquisition, sourcing, transportation, distribution, materiel, sustainment, readiness, and supplier resilience. This individual will analyze and draft policy, support staffing and coordination activities, assess Department-level impacts, and help translate SCRM requirements into practical guidance and implementation actions. The role requires strong DoW institutional knowledge, policy writing and analysis experience, executive communication skills, and the initiative to work independently across diverse stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities

• Support DoW supply chain risk management (SCRM) policy, oversight, governance, and enterprise coordination across logistics and supply chain disciplines.

• Analyze the impacts of SCRM policies, executive orders, guidance, and governance requirements across acquisition, sourcing, procurement, industrial base, transportation, distribution, materiel, maintenance, inventory, sustainment, readiness, and related mission areas.

• Draft, refine, staff, and coordinate policy documents, decision papers, briefings, talking points, memoranda, and status updates.

• Support the development and implementation of SCRM governance structures, processes, roles, responsibilities, and decision rights across DoW logistics and supply chain stakeholders.

• Track and manage logistics and supply chain equities, issues, risks, dependencies, and action items across DoW offices, commands, components, and mission stakeholders.

• Coordinate policy reviews, staffing packages, stakeholder comments, implementation activities, and follow-up actions across the Department.

• Prepare executive-level briefings, recommendations, read-aheads, and decision support materials for senior leaders.

• Assess how SCRM policies and governance decisions may affect DoW logistics operations, mission readiness, supply availability, supplier resilience, and critical dependencies.

• Translate policy, executive orders, and governance requirements into practical guidance and actionable steps for logistics and supply chain stakeholders.

• Support the development of oversight mechanisms, reporting cadences, performance measures, risk indicators, and implementation plans.

• Identify gaps, vulnerabilities, risks, and opportunities to improve SCRM execution across DoW logistics and supply chain functions.

• Facilitate communication up, out, and across the Department regarding SCRM priorities, decisions, risks, and implementation requirements.

• Support senior advisory activities in meetings, forums, working groups, and governance bodies.

• Operate as a self-starter who independently advances assigned work, anticipates coordination needs, and elevates issues requiring leadership attention.

Required Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in policy analysis, supply chain risk management, logistics, acquisition, sustainment, transportation, industrial base management, or related defense or federal work.

• Strong policy analysis, writing, staffing, and coordination experience.

• Demonstrated familiarity with DoW organizational structures, missions, decision-making processes, and institutional stakeholder environment.

• Experience supporting DoW policy, oversight, governance, enterprise coordination, or senior leadership activities.

• Ability to assess the Department-level impacts of SCRM policy and governance decisions across logistics and supply chain functions.

• Working knowledge of logistics and supply chain disciplines, including acquisition, sourcing, procurement, transportation, distribution, materiel, maintenance, inventory, sustainment, readiness, and supplier resilience.

• Experience preparing briefings, decision papers, recommendations, talking points, memoranda, executive correspondence, and other senior-level products.

• Strong stakeholder coordination skills, including experience working across multiple DoW offices, commands, components, and mission communities.

• Ability to analyze complex logistics and supply chain issues, identify risks and dependencies, synthesize information, and develop actionable recommendations.

• Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, and ability to work independently with limited direction.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with senior leaders and functional experts.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

• Must be available to work on-site in Alexandria, VA, up to five days per week.

• Secret clearance required.

Preferred Skills & Experience

• 8+ years of relevant experience in DoW policy, logistics, supply chain, SCRM, acquisition, sustainment, or related defense or federal functions.

• Experience supporting DoW headquarters, component, command, or enterprise-level logistics and supply chain policy or governance.

• Familiarity with defense industrial base risk, critical dependencies, supplier resilience, strategic materials, production capacity, transportation networks, and supply availability.

• Experience coordinating policy staffing packages and resolving comments across organizations with competing priorities.

• Experience assessing cross-functional impacts across logistics, acquisition, operations, sustainment, and readiness communities.

• Experience supporting senior DoW leaders, executive forums, working groups, or governance bodies.

• Familiarity with DoW acquisition, logistics, operational, and mission-support processes.

• Experience developing oversight frameworks, performance measures, reporting mechanisms, risk dashboards, or implementation plans.

The Senior Consultant is expected to approach assignments in the context of the Government's broader mission and objectives, anticipate risks and stakeholder needs, and support decisions through well-researched and data-driven analysis. The role requires the ability to independently manage assigned work while contributing effectively within a consulting team. These expectations align with Technical Assent's Senior Consultant level.

General Expectations

In addition to the responsibilities described above, a successful Senior Consultant at Technical Assent:

• Broadens their general knowledge, skills, and abilities within Technical Assent's Capability Areas and develops deeper practical expertise in project-specific capability areas.

• Participates in and applies Technical Assent's consulting approaches and methods.

• Shares knowledge with internal and external peers through writing and speaking approximately three to five times per year.

• Contributes to organizational capability by developing reusable process assets, templates, and tools that improve the consistency of Technical Assent's services.

• Supports business development by researching customer needs and the competitive environment and actively contributing to proposal efforts.

• Recognizes opportunities and helps define solutions that address customer needs.

• Maintains a professional demeanor consistent with Technical Assent's core values.

Work Location

On site at client facility in Alexandria, VA (Mark Center), up to 5 days per week.

Salary Range

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Virginia, Technical Assent is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Virginia and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Technical Assent, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $130,000.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

THE COMPANY

Technical Assent is passionate about services – in government, business, and not-for-profit. We design exceptional service experiences, engineer them to be robust, and deliver real capability and business outcomes for our clients. You will be working on government programs that have strategic importance to our client.  Your team will work IN and ON the client’s core mission – helping them to deliver their services day-to-day while simultaneously looking for opportunities to improve.  Our work is Driven by Evidence, Grounded in Understanding, and Focused on Impact.

A LITTLE ABOUT OUR CULTURE

We look for these attributes in our teammates.

• Our team combines the creative and the pragmatic to deliver the results that matter most to our clients. We see beauty when art and science come together.

• We seek self-starters, people who are confident in tackling challenges independently and bringing this to high-performing teams. We continually seek feedback from our customers and employees, looking for opportunities to grow.

• We are a small company which gives you an essential voice in shaping our culture. You will help grow our culture, and you will grow from the experience, too.

You will be part of a team to take an improvement concept and transform it into a capability – an asset that provides measurable value to our client’s mission.  The team will work with users, prototype, develop, and deliver new capabilities.  We hold ourselves accountable to impacting outcomes.

Additional Information:
Come as you are - Technical Assent is committed to a workplace free of discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. Hiring decisions are based solely on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We offer a highly competitive benefits package to all full-time employees that includes:

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 23,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.





OUR SOLUTION

Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.





OUR CULTURE & VALUES

Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, AI-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.




ROLE OVERVIEW

ButterflyMX is hiring for a Principal PM to lead the mobile product experience for a new and growing area of our business. You’ll own the mobile experience for this new surface area while solving the needs of property managers and operators who are part of the same ecosystem. This is a role for someone who can hit the ground running with existing momentum and still bring the curiosity and rigor to challenge what we think we know.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the product roadmap for this new area: evaluate what we’ve scoped, stress-test the assumptions, and evolve the plan based on what you learn

 - Conduct rigorous discovery by getting close to end users and operators, sharpening the problem definition while iterating with Design and Engineering on the solution

 - Embed AI into the product where it creates genuine value, not as a feature checkbox but as a lever for better experiences and smarter operations

 - Make smart calls about what we build versus partner versus white-label

 - Establish the metrics that matter and hold yourself accountable to them




REQUIREMENTS

 - 7+ years in product management with a track record of owning products from concept to market

 - Mobile-first instincts: you think in mobile experiences natively, understand what makes a consumer app sticky, and have shipped products people use on their phones

 - Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage product challenges: you can operate with a partial playbook, fill in the gaps, and make confident decisions with incomplete information

 - Strong discovery discipline: you know how to get close to customers, synthesize qualitative signal, and translate it into a clear product direction

 - AI-native thinking: you approach product problems by asking how intelligent systems can improve the experience, not by adding AI as an afterthought. You stay current on what the technology can actually do, and you bring that knowledge into discovery, design, and prioritization conversations

 - A builder’s mindset: you don’t just write specs and hand them off. You prototype, tinker, use the tools available to you today to explore ideas quickly, and you close the loop between what you ask engineering to build and how it actually works

 - Sharp communication skills: you can influence across engineering, design, go-to-market, and leadership by writing well, presenting clearly, and earning trust without authority




BONUS IF YOU HAVE AT LEAST ONE

 - Experience in proptech, multifamily real estate, or property operations

 - Experience building consumer mobile apps with meaningful engagement, retention, or marketplace dynamics

 - Experience navigating third-party integrations or white-label partnerships as part of a product strategy

 - Background in platforms where the end user and the buyer are different people: you understand that tension and know how to build for both
   
   
   


COMPENSATION

The expected base salary range for this position is $200,000-$240,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.



 


BENEFITS

 - Comprehensive Medical (ButterflyMX covers 90% of the cost), Dental, and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost) starting day 1

 - 401(k) plan with a match

 - 13 paid holidays, 25 PTO days

 - Paid Family Leave

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Quarterly self-care stipends

 - Access to optional benefits including pre-tax flexible healthcare spending accounts (FSA and HSA), Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits, as well as optional Supplemental Life, AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Disability, Legal, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet, and Personal Liability Insurance

 - And more!



ButterflyMX is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. You must have the authorization to work in the US to become an employee. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates and employees. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or the recruiting process, please let our recruiting team know.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Services
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
About the Team

At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It’s no simple task, but it wouldn’t be interesting if it was!

About the Role

Platform Services is one of DoorDash’s organizations responsible for extending DoorDash beyond the consumer marketplace. The team owns three distinct business lines: Drive, a white-label delivery API that enables external businesses to access DoorDash’s delivery network; Parcels, which provides last-mile logistics for retailers and merchants; and Enterprise (DoorDash for Business), a b2b product suite powering corporate meal programs and large ordering for organizations of all sizes.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Platform Services. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Enterprise, Drive, and Parcels, working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, extensible logistics capabilities for external businesses. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, operational tooling, and platform interfaces. They require strong technical judgment, cross organizational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.

You will report into the centralized Technical Program Management team in Engineering.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Drive Platform Services’ Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy & Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Platform Services’ strategy into executable technical programs. The portfolio spans Drive (DoorDash’s white-label delivery offering), Parcels (last-mile logistics for merchants and retailers), and Enterprise (DoorDash for Business) a b2b corporate meal and large order fulfillment platform serving organizations of all sizes.

• Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution - Platform Services depends on capabilities across logistics, merchant and partner integrations, dispatch and fulfillment, operational tooling, platform infrastructure, and the broader DoorDash ecosystem. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.

• Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking - You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, integrations, data flows, and operational systems behind Drive,Parcels, and Enterprise. You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect end-to-end delivery and partner experiences, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.

• Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action - Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.

• Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes - You will understand the merchant, partner, customer, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution. Whether the goal is expanding access to DoorDash logistics, improving delivery quality and reliability, enabling new partner use cases, or improving cost to serve, you will help teams stay focused on the technical work that matters most to the business.

We're excited about you because…

• You’re experienced in working with engineering teams on large-scale distributed systems and/or b2b products. You can speak to system architecture, scalability and reliability decisions, and design trade offs.

• You’re a strong leader with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.

• You have strong ownership, urgency, and drive. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to understand and drive your programs.

• You have excellent written & verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus. You can convey concepts and considerations to non-experts and experts alike.

• You’ve engaged with Engineering teams on product & platform development with a thorough understanding of software development processes and project planning.

• You are pragmatic and detailed in your approach and focus on progress, not perfection.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree with experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline.

• 5+ years recent experience as a Technical Program Manager at a technology company.

• Experience in large-scale distributed systems and system architecture.

• Experience working directly with engineering teams on product development, with a thorough understanding of software development processes, system architecture, and scalability trade-offs.

• Project planning and execution skills that include reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.

Compensation

The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.  Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay ranges for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Lyra Technology Group is a private equity-backed holding company that invests in and operates industry leading technology service businesses. Our companies are operated independently by exceptional management teams. Companies that join our group retain the employees, name, and culture that have made them successful. As a platform of Evergreen Services Group, we never divest from businesses we partner with and approach every decision with the goal of driving sustainable and healthy growth over the long term.

People 1st IT is looking for an experienced Level 3 Engineer / Senior Systems Engineer to join our technical team. This is a senior technical role focused primarily on project implementation, infrastructure improvements, migrations, advanced troubleshooting, and technical escalations within a managed services environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking ownership of complex technical projects from planning through implementation, working directly with clients, coordinating with vendors, documenting environments, and serving as an escalation resource for other technicians.

About People 1st….

People 1st IT Inc. is a San Francisco-based managed IT services provider serving small and mid-sized businesses throughout the greater Bay Area — including Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, Sonoma, and San Francisco counties. For nearly three decades, the company has served as a trusted technology partner across industries such as construction, law, financial services, real estate, and manufacturing, taking a proactive, relationship-driven approach rather than a reactive, ticket-based model. Its services span network administration, dedicated virtual CIO partnership, 24/7 centralized monitoring, and professional support, alongside cloud computing, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and phone systems — all backed by a hands-on, on-site presence that complements its remote monitoring capabilities.

Your work as a Senior Systems Engineer will include several components:

Infrastructure Projects & Migrations

• Plan and execute client IT infrastructure projects from beginning to completion.

• Lead Microsoft 365 migrations, tenant configuration, and related cloud projects.

• Design, deploy, migrate, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Active Directory environments.

• Perform server migrations, upgrades, virtualization projects, and infrastructure modernization.

Cloud & Collaboration Platforms

• Implement and support Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive.

Networking & Security

• Design and troubleshoot networks, including firewalls, switches, wireless infrastructure, VLANs, VPNs, and site-to-site connectivity.

• Deploy and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions.

Technical Escalation & Client Support

• Perform advanced troubleshooting and serve as an escalation point for Level 1 and Level 2 technicians.

• Perform client infrastructure assessments and recommend technical improvements.

• Coordinate with third-party vendors, ISPs, software providers, and other technology partners.

• Assist with critical incidents and complex technical issues when necessary.

Documentation & Communication

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, diagrams, credentials, configurations, and project notes.

• Create implementation plans, migration plans, and project documentation.

• Communicate technical issues and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

• Participate in occasional onsite client work throughout the Bay Area.

Our ideal Sr Systems Engineer has the following qualifications:

• Several years of senior-level IT infrastructure experience, preferably within an MSP environment.

• Ability to independently manage technical projects with limited supervision.

• Independently completed projects such as Microsoft 365 migrations, server and Active Directory migrations, file server and SharePoint migrations, office relocations and new-site deployments, firewall and network replacements, Wi-Fi deployments, cloud migrations, backup and disaster recovery implementations, infrastructure upgrades, tenant-to-tenant migrations, and security and identity improvements.

• Strong experience with several of the following: Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Exchange Online, SharePoint and OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.

• Windows Server, Active Directory / Group Policy / DNS / DHCP, Microsoft Azure, and Hyper-V and/or VMware.

• Microsoft Intune / endpoint management, and endpoint security / EDR solutions.

• Firewalls, switches, VLANs, VPNs, and wireless networking, including Ubiquiti / UniFi environments.

• VOIP systems, backup and disaster recovery platforms, and remote monitoring and management platforms.

• MSP documentation and ticketing systems, and domain, DNS, SSL, and certificate management.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across servers, cloud platforms, networks, and endpoints.

• Comfortable working directly with executives, managers, vendors, and client IT contacts.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to prioritize multiple client projects and technical issues simultaneously.

• Reliable transportation and ability to occasionally travel to client locations in the Bay Area.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and will operate on a hybrid basis, with a base compensation range of $135,000–$145,000.

We are seeking a candidate who goes beyond ticket-based support. The ideal candidate will be comfortable owning projects end-to-end, making sound technical decisions, solving complex problems, and taking full responsibility for client infrastructure. This includes the ability to receive a project objective, assess the existing environment, develop an implementation plan, coordinate the necessary resources, execute the work, test the solution, document it thoroughly, and hand it off successfully to the support team.  If you are a motivated, detail-oriented professional seeking a senior role within a Managed Service Provider (MSP), we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer ensures the reliability, availability, and performance of large-scale software systems through a blend of software engineering and systems administration. Key responsibilities involve automating operational tasks, improving observability, and contributing to incident management, while also collaborating with development and technology teams to build more reliable and scalable applications.

Join Altium as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the reliability and performance of the Altium Cloud Platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

• Understanding how an Altium Cloud Platform works
• Pioneer improvements in observability, including logging, monitoring, and application performance management (APM), ensuring system reliability and proactive issue detection.
• Develop and implement reliability frameworks and patterns that standardize and elevate the resilience of our SaaS products across multiple regions and environments.
• Cultivate a shared responsibility model where the SRE team collaborates with and educates engineering teams on reliability best practices.
• Contribute to incident response and management, ensuring rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and post-incident analysis for continuous improvement.
• Participate in system design consulting, platform management, infrastructure upgrades and capacity planning.
• Partner closely with engineering and development teams to enhance product stability, observability, and manageability through best practices in reliability engineering.
• Partner closely with DevOps/Operations, drive automation initiatives, promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and streamline deployment processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
• Champion Service-Oriented Organization (SOO) principles to ensure accountability and clarity in service ownership.
• Participate in on-call rotation and drive operational improvements after incidents.

• 6+ years in SRE, DevOps or related role in a large-scale environment
• 3+ years professional experience in software development
• Software development experience (ideally working with and as a .NET developer)
• Strong understanding of SDLC, microservice and HA architecture
• Observability - NewRelic, ELK, Grafana, PagerDuty, OTEL or similar
• Experience with Kubernetes clusters in production setting, AWS, IOC
• Experience with operational tasks
• Knowledge of CI-CD tooling Jenkins, Gitlab, GitHub, ArgoCD or similar
• Knowledge of IaaC Terraform, Ansible
• Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals
• Experience with relational databases (mysql, postgres) as a plus
• MUST be a US permanent resident (Citizen or Green Card)

jobs.title: Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Information Security Officer to become the central Point of Contact for our Robins on all matters related to information security.

Reporting directly to the Head of Information Security, you will be responsible for maintaining our Information Security Management System and coordinating key improvement projects. On a day-to-day basis, your focus will be the theoretical and compliance backbone of our security, leading our ISO certification efforts and updating policies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage, document, and update information security policies and procedures, ensuring they remain current, accessible, and compliant with standards like ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS2.

 - Lead the theoretical and compliance preparation for internal and external audits, focusing heavily on achieving and maintaining our ISO certifications.

 - Perform regular risk assessments to proactively identify areas for improvement and coordinate targeted security projects across the company.

 - Assess information security incidents, identify root causes, and coordinate the implementation of robust corrective actions.

 - Organize periodic, engaging awareness programs to educate employees on security protocols, regulatory requirements, and threat prevention.

 - Act as the trusted advisor for all employees regarding security questions.

 - Manage relationships with external stakeholders, including company lawyers, consultants, suppliers, government authorities, and audit/ISO certification bodies.


REQUIREMENTS

 - A BA/MSc or HBO degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

 - 5+ years of experience in Information Security, Risk Management, and/or Compliance.

 - Strong knowledge of security frameworks, GDPR, and IT management, with a distinct focus on ISO 27001 audits and assessments.

 - A background or strong affinity with the high-tech and engineering sectors.

 - A solid grasp of security concepts and tools (e.g., firewalls, IDS, antivirus) to collaborate effectively with the operational security team.

 - Professional fluency in English, Dutch is a plus.

 - An agile, curious, and proactive work ethic with excellent problem-solving skills.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with people from diverse cultures and backgrounds.


N.B. All applicants, we realize that this is quite the list and people come with various levels of experience. Don't be afraid to apply even if you feel you don't meet every desired skill. Our mission is a journey and there's plenty to learn on the way! But of course, you should identify with our core values: We trust, We own it & We aim high.

Also please be aware that we will request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background check according to our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter.


WHAT'S IN FOR YOU

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® https://www.greatplacetowork.nl/en/certification/certified/robin-radar-systems certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, noise canceling headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Router Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Principal Router Architect with 10 to 15 years of experience to define the backbone of next-generation Zonal and Central Compute Automotive architectures. This role focuses on architecting high-bandwidth, ultra-reliable Ethernet Routing Engines and PCIe subsystems that serve as the primary data fabric for Autonomous Driving (AD) and Cockpit controllers. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-speed data center-grade throughput and the rigorous Safety (ISO 26262) and Deterministic Networking requirements of the automotive industry.

Responsibilities:

• Automotive Ethernet Routing: Architect L2/L3 switch fabrics supporting Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) standards (e.g., IEEE 802.1AS, 802.1Qbv, 802.1Qbu) to ensure deterministic latency for safety-critical traffic.
• PCIe Backbone Architecture: Define PCIe Gen 5/6 integration for high-speed chip-to-chip connectivity between SoCs, AI accelerators, and storage, including support for SR-IOV to virtualize resources across multiple Virtual Machines (VMs).
• Functional Safety (ASIL): Integrate hardware safety mechanisms (ECC, Parity, BIST, and End-to-End protection) to meet ASIL-B/D requirements within the routing engine and bus fabrics.
• Zonal Interconnect & Bus Fabric: Design the interface between Ethernet/PCIe controllers and internal NoC/CHI fabrics, ensuring efficient data movement for ADAS sensors (Camera, LiDAR) and telemetry.
• Virtualization & Security: Architect hardware-assisted isolation and Secure On-board Communication (SecOC) to protect the vehicle network from cyber threats while allowing shared access to network resources.
• Infrastructure & Power: Define robust clock, reset, and power management schemes capable of operating under automotive thermal profiles and supporting rapid "Instant-On" boot requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (PhD desirable)
• Experience: 12+ years in high-speed networking or SoC architecture, with at least 5 years focused on Automotive-grade silicon.
• TSN Mastery: Deep expertise in IEEE 802.1 TSN protocols and their hardware implementation for real-time traffic shaping and synchronization.
• Protocol Expertise: Expert knowledge of PCIe (Root Complex/Endpoint) and Automotive Ethernet (10BASE-T1S to 10G+ levels).
• Automotive Standards: Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional safety flows and AEC-Q100 reliability requirements.
• System Integration: Proven track record of integrating routing engines into complex SoCs using AXI/CHI bus protocols and managing IOMMU configurations.

jobs.title: Underground Electrician
jobs.description:
The Underground Electrician aims to repair and maintain associated surface fixed equipment and underground infrastructure equipment.

1. Daily Tasks

• Install, maintain, inspect, and repair underground electrical systems including power distribution, lighting, communication, and control systems
• Troubleshoot electrical faults on fixed plant and mobile mining equipment
• Perform preventative maintenance and inspections to minimize downtime and improve reliability
• Read and interpret electrical schematics, drawings, and manuals
• Install and maintain substations, switchgear, transformers, VFDs, and motor control systems

2. Safety

• Safely work on low, medium, and high-voltage systems in accordance with site procedures and legislation
• Conduct lockout/tagout (LOTO), grounding, and testing procedures
• Identify electrical hazards and participate in risk assessments and job hazard analyses (JHAs)
• Accurately complete work orders, inspection reports, and maintenance records
• Respond to breakdowns and emergency repairs as required
• Follow all MSHA/OSHA regulations, site safety policies, and electrical codes
• Maintain a strong focus on personal safety, coworker safety, and equipment protection

3. Teamwork

• Work closely with maintenance, operations, and engineering teams to support production goals
• Participate in safety meetings, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives

• On-the-job experience and vocational training
• Must adhere to the OceanaGold Code of Conduct
• Journeyman Electrician certification or equivalent trade qualification
• Minimum 10 years of experience as an electrician, preferably in underground mining or heavy industrial environments
• Strong knowledge of underground mining electrical systems and regulations
• Experience with medium-voltage systems, PLCs, VFDs, and mining mobile equipment preferred
• Ability to work in confined spaces and physically demanding underground conditions
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
• Electrical diagnostics and fault finding
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Strong communication and documentation skills
• Mechanical aptitude and attention to detail
• Commitment to safety, reliability, and continuous improvement

Knowledge & Core Functional Competencies:

To ensure compliance with Haile Gold Mine electrical safety standards, all electricians are required to successfully complete the following training and certifications as a condition of continued employment:

• CPR, AED, and Live Voltage Rescue (2 hours)
• Low Voltage Worker Training (8 hours)
• High Voltage Worker Training (8 hours) – required for electricians working on systems greater than 1,000 volts
• Low Voltage Induction (3 hours)
• High Voltage Induction (3 hours) – required for electricians working on systems greater than 1,000 volts
• NEC Awareness Online Training (10 hours)
• HGM Authorized Isolator Training

Hiring Requirement: These certifications are not required at the time of hire.

Employment Requirement: Successful completion of all applicable training and certifications is required to maintain employment in the Electrician position. The employer will provide and fund all required training and certification programs.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to work in both office and operational mining environments.
• Ability to regularly access active mining and processing areas to support operational teams, conduct site visits, investigations, coaching, and workforce engagement activities.
• Ability to walk on uneven terrain, climb stairs and access elevated work areas as required.
• Ability to wear and use mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE).

WHAT'S ON OFFER:

• Competitive salary + short-term and long-term bonus
• Comprehensive benefits package including health, vision and dental insurance, 401K, and more
• Great residential location close to Charlotte SC, and is located between the mountains and sea.
• Long service recognition
• Living Our Values recognition program
• In-office snack shop
• Monthly paid training available and professional development
• Supportive work environment with a focus on safety and teamwork
• Access to OceanaGold Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

YOU MATTER: OceanaGold is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We believe a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. Should you require any assistance applying for this opportunity, please contact us at careers@oceanagold.com

jobs.description:

The Registered Neurodiagnostic Technologist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• This position provides neurological testing and/or monitoring in any or all of the following clinical areas and modalities: A. standard, long-term, or ambulatory Electroencephalography (EEG); B. Electromyography (EMG) and Nerve Conduction Studies.
• This position may also provide neurological testing and/or monitoring in any or all of the following additional clinical areas and modalities: A. Visual, auditory, or somatosensory Evoked Potentials (EP) or Electronystagmography; C. Intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring (IONM).
• The Registered Neurodiagnostic Technologist works closely with other members of the Neurological Testing Center (NTC) staff, including physicians.

Responsibilities:

Essential Functions and How They Are Accomplished:

• Complete all required paperwork before study is performed including relevant patient history. Clarify unclear or inappropriate orders. Complete billing information upon completion of procedure.
• Independently prepare patient for test and/or monitoring by accurately placing recording electrodes and using established protocols required for the procedure.
• Recognize technically inadequate signals and obtain troubleshooting assistance if necessary.
• Recognize abnormalities/potential changes and respond appropriately by communicating to a Coordinator, or appropriate neurologist.
• Maintain equipment in clean and organized condition, including stocking supplies as needed.
• Record study and enter appropriate notations and clinical observations.
• Encourage teamwork through interdepartmental communication and constructive problem resolution.
• Provide training for new Neurodiagnostic Technicians and student preceptors.

Patient Care/Age Specific Responsibilities and Qualifications:

• Provide patient with procedure explanation, address questions, and reassure and relax patient (as appropriate), and prepares patients for their procedure. Provide assistance to older adults as necessary through assessment of impairments that affect testing procedures.
• Provides basic personal hygiene assistance to any patients as necessary.
• Primarily requires interaction with patients of adult and geriatric age. Interaction with neonates will be required for technicians performing EEG's.

Additional Functions:

• Provide technical or administrative coverage in other areas of NTC as necessary.
• Participate in departmental in-services, monthly staff meetings, and continuing education.
• Assist in report typing, distribution, filing and other storage duties as assigned.
• Provide consistent feedback and suggestions for improvement to NTC Resource Coordinator and/or Manager.
• Provide written and/or verbal feedback to NTC Resource Coordinator and/or Manager on Neurodiagnostic Technician and/or student preceptor's performance.

Quality Management Responsibilities:

• Participates in organizational and departmental quality improvement activities.
• Communicates customer satisfaction issues to appropriate individuals.
• Provides ideas and suggestions for process improvements within the department.

Required Education/Experience and License/Certification:

• High School diploma or equivalent
• CPR certified in basic cardiac life support (BLS) through the American Heart Association (AHA).
• Registry in respective discipline (EEG, EMG) corresponding with the clinical area of work for the institution.Registered Electroencephalographic Technologist (R.EEG.T) through the American Board of Registration of Electroencephalographic and Evoked Potential technologists (ABRET) for EEGRegistered Nerve Conduction Technologist (R. NCS T.) through the American Association of Electrodiagnostic Technologists (AAET) OR Certified Nerve Conduction Technologist (CNCT) through American Board of Electrodiagnostic Medicine (ABEM) for EMG
• In lieu of registry, candidate may be considered who are board registry eligible, and complete registration within 12 months of hire date.

Preferred License/Certification and Regulatory Agency:

• In addition to EEG or EMG, registration in one or more of the following disciplines: EEG, EP, CLTM, CNIM Registration through the American Board of Registration of Electroencephalographic and Evoked Potential technologists (ABRET) for EP, CLTM, CNIM

• Prior experience in multiple ENDT modalities.
