• The Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) is a multi-skilled worker who assumes a wide range of clinical and administrative roles within the physician office setting. Under the supervision of a Physician and/or the direction of a licensed nurse, the CMA provides direct and indirect patient care, performs laboratory and other testing, and may assist with clerical functions. The CMA serves as a key team player when interacting and communicating with patients and/or clinical staff in the ambulatory care environment.

Responsibilities:

• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions or help to patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Rooms patients and provides direct patient care under the supervision of a physician, and/or direction of an RN/LPN. Records medical, surgical and family histories, medications and vital signs. Prepares patients for office procedures and assists nursing and medical staff with routine examinations and patient treatments. Always considers specific patient needs; administers care according to individual age and abilities.
• Explains treatment procedures to patients; reinforces patient education regarding medication and special diets or testing that has been provided by the RN/LPN or physician (for example, the After Visit Summary).
• Administers injections and medications as directed by physician.
• Performs point of care testing, including venipuncture, urine dips, finger sticks, strep screens, flu screens, pregnancy tests, and cultures. Independently performs other tests and/or office procedures such as EKG's, pulmonary testing, and chronic disease management testing.
• Is knowledgeable about the purpose, process and results for tests and lab specimens frequently performed in an office setting.
• Relays NORMAL test results to patient or reads results, verbatim, from the physician documentation. Consults an RN, LPN, or physician should the patient have questions regarding their results.
• Adheres to CDPG Environment of Care policies. Maintains infection control standards for exam/procedure rooms and areas where patient care services are delivered. Cleans, disinfects, changes linen etc. Performs quality checks and trouble-shoots office instruments. Is knowledgeable of sterilization techniques and biological indicators for sterilization.
• Participates in shared governance, committee work, and practice/department projects.
• Demonstrates the knowledge of proper identification and reporting of medical/health care errors.
• Demonstrates a willingness to support co-workers; voluntarily pitches in. Willing to mentor and train new staff. Acts as an integral member of the team.
• Communicates appropriately and clearly with all. Maintains a good working relationship within the office and other ancillary departments. Demonstrates a positive attitude.
• Handles situations in a mature and professional manner.
• Prioritizes and re-prioritizes workflow and maintain an organized workspace.
• Engages in teamwork as a team player and a team builder.
• Meets current standards and policies for documentation. Provides documentation that is timely, accurate, up to date, complete and legible.
• Charges for all ancillary services performed
• Participates in ongoing educational activities appropriate to the area of practice. Seeks experiences, formal and independent learning activities to maintain and develop clinical and professional skills and knowledge. Shares knowledge from continuing education programs with co-workers.
• Exhibits creativity and flexibility through the dynamics of change.
• Appropriately utilizes the functionality of the medical record and practice management systems within their job responsibilities, for example, all documentation, order entry, results, referrals, etc.
• Stays informed of medical record and practice management system updates and implements into daily work.
• Utilizes online resources efficiently including Outlook, Corridors, and Team Sites.
• Completes other duties as assigned

Required:

• Two or more years of recent experience working as a Medical Assistant in a physician office setting or completion of an accredited Medical Assisting Program
• High School Diploma or equivalent with 2 or more years of experience as Medical Assistant or completion of an accredited Medical Assisting Program
• American Heart Association accredited Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) certification.
• Completion of phlebotomy class or equivalent experience. Basic computer knowledge. Ability to type proficiently and accurately. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing. Ability to assess and determine situations requiring an interpreter and to use interpreter services effectively.
• New graduates/hires must obtain certification/registration within 1 year from hire date. The following certifications will be accepted:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP)An active RN or LPN license in the state of Illinois will be accepted in lieu of CMA certification

Preferred:

• Associates degree in Medical Assisting
• Second language proficiency a plus

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

• Own and execute a territory growth strategy
• Grow relationships with contractors and dealers across the Twin Cities Metro
• Expand Techo-Bloc's presence into South Dakota
• Generate new business and expand existing accounts
• Educate contractors and drive demand through our dealer network
• Support dealer merchandising, displays, training, and events
• Monitor market trends and competitive activity
• Represent Techo-Bloc at trade shows, lunch & learns, and dealer events
• Use CRM and data to manage your pipeline and prioritize opportunities

What We're Looking For

• Proven B2B field sales experience; hardscape, landscaping, building materials, or dealer-network experience is an asset
• Strong track record of building relationships and growing revenue
• Self-motivated, competitive, and comfortable owning a territory
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills
• Comfortable with CRM and data-driven sales processes
• Valid driver's license and willingness to travel and be in the field with customers

Why This Territory: This is the best of both worlds: an established market with real infrastructure and brand recognition already in place, plus meaningful whitespace to grow — especially as we extend into South Dakota. You'll spend less time proving the brand and more time growing it.

Career Path & Earning Potential Techo-Bloc offers a structured career path with clear opportunities to grow into more senior sales roles as your experience and results build. Compensation includes a competitive base salary, performance-based bonus opportunities, and a vehicle allowance for field travel.

Benefits A comprehensive benefits package including medical coverage, retirement plan matching, and the equipment you need to succeed in the field, backed by a structured onboarding and mentorship program to help you get up to speed in an established market.

Techo-Bloc is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Adult Oncology Social Wrkr Oncology Full time
jobs.description:
Completes social history, psychological assessment with each patient and activity, and participates in the interdisciplinary care plan and

team meetings. Assists patients and families with personal, economic and environmental difficulties. Assesses and assists patient and

families with available community resources. Utilizes expertise and problem solving skills to achieve optimal clinical outcomes within

effective resources and timeframe.

Responsibilities:

• Participates as a member of the Interdisciplinary Team and attends interdisciplinary care conferences, multi-disciplinary care clinics, tumor boards and Oncology grand rounds regularly.
• Demonstrates patient advocacy role through communication and documentation.
• Identifies, assesses and responds to patient and family needs in the Loyola Cancer Care and Research Center and CDH Infusion Center, incorporating psychological, cultural and spiritual needs. Emphasis is placed on addressing the social and emotional needs of the patient and family that may impact the patient's response to medical treatment. These needs may include, but are not limited to, adjustment to illness, poor or limited coping abilities, functional impairment, mental illness, guardianship issues, compliance, need for additional resources due to limited funds available, cultural differences, death, bereavement, welfare, including abuse, neglect and domestic violence.
• Maintains patient and family educational activities and support groups.
• Provides timely and effective interventions for patients and families in emergency and crisis, including referrals to appropriate support services.
• Educates team members regarding the socio-economic, emotional and cultural issues that impact the care delivery, coping skills and response to treatment.
• Provides staff emotional support and education on coping skills as they handle emotional patient care activities.
• Assists with the planning, implementation and follow up for Oncology Services Outreach activities. Serves as the community Outreach Coordinator on the CDH Cancer Committee.
• Serves as a lead resource and assists with referrals in coordinating charity, financial resources, community support services such as American Cancer Society, Livingwell, Gilda's Club, Wellness House etc.
• Documents in clinical record appropriate interventions and plans for ongoing services.
• Assists patient/family with adjustment to illness and medical environment as evidenced by clinical documentation.
• Documents all referrals and clinical interventions related to their cancer care within clinical record in appropriate time frame.
• Provides daily documentation of education and evidence of team work in patient record.
• Documents patient's and/or family's understanding of barriers related to appropriate care and transition planning as evidenced through clinical record documentation.
• Seeks information and understands impact of clinical data. Demonstrates same by documentation and family/patient understanding and response to clinical information.
• Identifies and facilitates education of patients and families on end of life issues and community resources.
• Attends inservices/conferences to enhance professional development and to maintain Illinois licensure.
• Remains current with respect to regulations and ensures compliance. Maintains familiarity with drug reimbursement plans.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• MSW

Licensure:

• LSW

• Must have and maintain active and current state of Illinois License

Experience:

• 2 to 3 years experience in medical social work role in an acute hospital setting or agency.

• Must have prior experience in Oncology.

Preferred:

• 5 years oncology experience.
• ACSW (Academy of Certified Social Workers) Preferred.

• Provides mammography and DEXA imaging and patient care services at defined levels to patients.

Responsibilities:

• Maintains accountability for patient safety throughout the imaging process, including screening, preparation, monitoring, and post-procedure care.
• Produces diagnostic-quality images using approved protocols and professional standards.

• Reviews images prior to exam completion and initiates corrective action when diagnostic adequacy is not met.
• Administers contrast in accordance with policy, including screening for contraindications and patient monitoring (as applicable).

• Identifies equipment performance issues and initiates follow-up through established service processes.
• Coordinates exam flow and prioritizes time-sensitive studies.

• Ensures a positive patient experience throughout care delivery
• Supports department initiatives to improve relationships, reliability, efficiency, growth
• Supports additional responsibilities aligned with patient care and department needs
• Performs breast screening exams, diagnostic mammograms and bone density (Dexa) scans, as needed.

• Supplies patient with relevant patient education materials
• Verifies correct order for exam scheduled and aligns with previous recommendation prior to all exams.

jobs.title: Starlink Global Operations Manager (Country Launch)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

STARLINK GLOBAL OPERATIONS MANAGER (COUNTRY LAUNCH)

Starlink is providing high-speed broadband to the world. This role combines traditional business planning and analysis with broader business decision-making and strategy, directly supporting Starlink's leadership. Global Operations is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near-term execution and long-term planning. Team members are expected to analyze data and provide recommendations and to lead cross-functional decision-making and implementation of the recommendations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop comprehensive execution plan to implement market requirements for initial market access and rapid growth of operations

• Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as the timeliness of activation upon full authorization in a market, product accessibility, and Starlink’s operational health in live markets

• Guide planning and resource management for specific verticals within Starlink, including development of business models

• Identify initiatives for improvement of Starlink's business outlook, including developing, tracking, and executing business initiatives with Starlink's leadership

• Identify and lead implementation of process and system enhancements to improve handoffs and execution across various teams, evolve the customer experience, or scale the business while balancing resources

• Collaborate and partner with cross functional teams in order to build a strong networking across these departments and with external resources to ensure compliance

• Support and educate internal stakeholders on market requirements and timeframes, working collaboratively to achieve company objectives

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in STEM, business, economics, or finance

• 4+ years of experience in business operations, project management, or strategic planning

• 1+ year experience based abroad or working with operations outside of the United States

• 1+ year of experience with analytical skills (e.g. Microsoft Office applications, Excel modeling, etc.)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Demonstrated success working in an environment with competing priorities and aggressive schedules

• Experience leading complex operational and strategic initiatives

• Ability to define and manage a project independently

• Experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)

• Experience using various programming languages (e.g Python, Javascript, R, SQL, HTML, XML, CSS, Ruby)

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior business leaders

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to travel up to 50%

• Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends

• This is not a remote position and would require being onsite

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Credit Control Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role

Responsible for managing credit risk, collections, and query resolution across a key customer portfolio to support working capital optimisation. Drives process improvement initiatives, automation, and accurate reporting to enable strong team performance against monthly collection targets.

Key Responsibilities

This role operates on a hybrid work policy based at our Shared Service Centre in Cork, Ireland.

• Drive cross-functional dispute resolution workflows and root cause analysis with Sales and Customer Service, enforcing strict SLAs to prevent dispute escalation and minimise aged unallocated cash.
• Evaluate credit holds and execute autonomous order release decisions within designated delegated authority limits, balancing commercial urgency with credit risk exposure.
• Conduct periodic financial risk assessments and credit limit reviews for new and existing accounts using third-party risk data and financial statements, submitting recommendations for approval.
• Monitor account balances and enforce compliance with agreed credit limits and payment terms through strategic stakeholder engagement.
• Monitor and resolve unallocated cash and unapplied receipts promptly to ensure customer sub-ledgers accurately reflect real-time exposure.

Required:

• At least 12 months of experience in an Accounts Receivable (AR) or Credit Control environment.
• Educated to at least Certificate or Diploma level.
• Fluency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Skills you need to succeed:

• Excellent numeracy and analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs) and/or MS Excel.
• Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., Oracle, Fusion, or Microsoft Dynamics) and credit risk evaluation.

What we offer

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

- Financial Security & Health:

*Health Care Contribution and a robust Pension Scheme for your future.

*Employee Assistance Programme in place to support your wellbeing and trained peer mental health ambassadors on site.

*Eye Care Contribution for your visual health.

- Work-Life Balance & Flexibility:

*Vacation days increase with service, alongside 2 Company Days.

*Benefit from Flexible Working arrangements and family-friendly policies for work-life balance.

- Continuous Development working for a continuously evolving organisation:

*Professional Memberships paid (related to role).

*Continuous professional development: time provided to attend professional updates specific to role.

*We're an ACCA accredited training partner, offering top-tier professional development.

- Site Perks & Community:

*Parking is available on site for your convenience.

*Join our Sports & Social Club for engaging activities.

*Join our Sustainability, DE&I, Wellness Teams depending on your personal interest.

*Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) day per annum to support our local charities under Avery Dennison Granting Wishes Foundation.

*Ad hoc small initiatives annually as guided by our various committees.

We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com. The site employs approximately 85 talented individuals on yearly basis both for permanent and temporary assignments. We deliver world-class financial services, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, VAT, Tax, Statutory, US GAAP reporting, Global Projects, Continuous Improvement and IT Projects, in partnership with our Business Process Outsourcer, Accenture, to support Avery Dennison's operations. jobs.title: Founding Sales Manager, Emerging Enterprise
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Sales Manager to lead our Emerging Enterprise (EEnt) team — the reps responsible for winning multi-location dental groups and emerging DSOs in the 4–9 location range. Reporting to the Head of Emerging Enterprise, you'll lead a team of experienced, quota-carrying Account Executives running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

This is the newest team inside Dandy's fastest-growing business segment, which means the playbook isn't fully baked yet. You'll have real latitude to create, build, and develop: the processes, the enablement, and most importantly the talent. If you want a seat where your fingerprints are on how a team operates rather than inheriting someone else's system, this is it.



What You'll Do

 - Own the strategy, structure, and quota performance of the EEnt team, including territory design, account prioritization, and outbound motion into multi-location groups

 - Sell alongside, coach, and develop a team of senior Account Executives — and build the ramp, career path, and performance bar that scales beyond your first cohort

 - Build the team playbook from the ground up: discovery frameworks for multi-location decision committees, business-case and ROI models, mutual action plans, pilot-to-rollout expansion paths, and competitive positioning against national labs and chairside milling

 - Coach to deal strategy, not just activity:  pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecast accuracy, and multi-threading discipline

 - Lead by example: engage directly in your team's most strategic opportunities, running exec-level conversations and helping navigate to close

 - Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Enterprise Onboarding/CS, Clinical, and Lab Operations to land accounts that scan, order, and expand across every location

 - Use Salesforce and the broader sales stack to drive rigorous pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and performance visibility

 - Work with the Head of Emerging Enterprise and senior sales leadership on KPIs, capacity planning, and revenue targets



What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years of sales experience in a high-growth environment, with at least 3 years managing teams of 7+ individual reps (SaaS or B2B experience highly preferred)

jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer
jobs.description:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

About the Role

A Value Engineer at Rimes bridges the gap between what our platform does and the business outcomes our clients need in order to justify, accelerate, and expand their investment. Where Sales Engineers lead with technical depth and product demonstration, you will lead with the client's business context: their strategic pressures, their cost of inaction, and the quantified case for change.

Your job is to make the decision to buy — and to expand — obvious to the people who control the budget. A Sales Engineer shows what Rimes does; a Value Engineer proves why it matters, in the client's language, using the client's numbers, speaking to the client's strategic agenda.

Why This Role Exists

Enterprise deals face challenges against buying committees, expanding sets of stakeholders and elongated sales cycles. Buyers stall when they cannot articulate value internally, when the case for change does not survive finance review, or when the champion lacks the ammunition to move their own organization.

Organizations that align their GTM motion around business value rather than product features see win rates increase 19–32%, sales cycles shorten by up to 28%, lower discount pressure, and stronger renewal and expansion rates. Rimes addresses genuine strategic pain — data quality, time-to-market, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency — for asset managers and asset owners with real, quantifiable consequences when those problems go unsolved. We have the substance and deliver the value. This role supplies the methodology and engages cross-functionally and externally in these conversations.

Value engineering cannot be a part-time responsibility layered onto existing roles. Sales teams are measured on pipeline and closing; Sales Engineers focus on fit and feasibility; Account Managers focus on relationships and renewals. This is a distinct discipline requiring financial modeling, executive facilitation, cross-functional influence, and the ability to build tools that lift the entire organization.

What You'll Do

Value Intelligence — Understanding What We Deliver

Develop an authoritative, evidence-based understanding of the value Rimes actually delivers. This is primary research work.

• Conduct structured interviews with Sales, Sales Engineering, Account Management, and Customer Success to document where clients have experienced impact — time saved, errors eliminated, audits passed, processes automated

• Run voice-of-customer sessions with existing clients to capture realized outcomes and quantified benefits

• Research how competitors frame value and claim about business impact in adjacent segments

• Review existing case studies, metrics libraries, and client testimonials to systematize the evidence Rimes already has

• Build and maintain a living outcomes library: value drivers, proof points, benchmarks, and stories organized by solution and buyer persona

Value Articulation — Translating Capability into Outcomes

Translate Rimes' capabilities into business-outcome language that resonates with economic buyers. This is the core intellectual product of the function.

• Value propositions by solution — Managed Data Services, Performance, Regulatory Reporting — that lead with the business problem and the cost of not solving it, not with features

• Financial models and ROI frameworks that quantify impact using client-specific inputs: AUM, headcount, operational costs, error rates, time-to-market

• Business case narratives structured around the client's strategic priorities rather than Rimes' product roadmap

• Persona-specific messaging: cost reduction and risk mitigation for the CFO, efficiency and scale for the COO, integration and data quality for the CIO

• A distinct value story for each stage of the client lifecycle — new acquisition, expansion, and renewal

GTM Tools and Assets

Build the tools that make value-based selling accessible across the GTM team.

• ROI calculator and worked examples: an interactive, client-facing model with clearly labelled inputs (AUM, data operations FTEs, current vendor costs, error rate, time-to-report) and pre-built formulas producing cost savings, efficiency gains, ROI, and payback

• Pre-populated illustrative scenarios — mid-size asset manager, large asset owner, fund administrator — using representative, internally validated inputs that sellers can walk a prospect through before any client numbers exist

• Business case templates: presentation-ready frameworks Sales can populate for economic buyers at key deal stages

• Use cases written from client pain points with a business-outcomes orientation, anonymized where needed, highlighting quantitative and qualitative impact

Enablement, Coaching, and Culture Change

Shift how the GTM team sells — leading with the client's business problem rather than Rimes' product. This is the hardest part of the role.

• Join live deals at discovery and proposal stages to model value-based discovery and executive business case presentation

• Coach AEs and SEs before and after client interactions to sharpen discovery questions, value framing, and business case narratives

• Design and deliver training on value selling methodology — MEDDPICC, economic impact modeling, executive storytelling, and competitive reframing

• Operationalize MEDDPICC as a genuine qualification framework for economic impact and path-to-funded-decision, not a CRM checkbox

• Enable Sales leadership to coach these behaviors in the field, creating a multiplier effect beyond your own bandwidth

• Earn credibility with experienced sellers by demonstrating that this approach wins bigger deals and reduces discounting — not by telling them they have been doing it wrong

Value Realization — Proving Impact After the Sale

Close the loop between the value promised in the business case and the value the client actually receives. Post-sale defensibility is what makes the pre-sale case credible.

• Run post-sale value assessments with Customer Success and Account Management to measure realized outcomes against the original business case

• Build TCO and total-value-of-ownership frameworks alongside ROI — cost-benefit analysis that holds up under procurement and CFO scrutiny

• Partner with RevOps to instrument the function: pipeline influenced, win rate, deal size, and cycle length for VE-supported versus non-supported deals

• Feed realized outcomes back into the outcomes library, case studies, and renewal and expansion narratives

How You'll Partner Across Rimes

This role has no direct reports and no quota. Its leverage comes from influence across four groups, none of which sit in its reporting line.

• Sales and Sales Engineering — deal support at discovery and proposal, business case development on strategic pursuits, MEDDPICC coaching, competitive reframing, and quarterly win/loss pattern reviews

• Account Management and Customer Success — expansion business cases, renewal justification and price-increase support, quantified outcomes for QBRs, and voice-of-customer capture for the outcomes library

• Product and Marketing — market-facing value evidence to inform roadmap prioritization, outcome-based launch messaging, value proof points and win stories for content, and economic-buyer language for campaigns

• Finance and Leadership — agreement on modeling assumptions and conservative value estimates, defensible ROI claims for procurement, pricing and value-to-price narratives, and a board-level view of Rimes' differentiated business impact

What Success Looks Like

Your impact should be visible and measurable within 12–18 months.

• A documented outcomes library: quantified value drivers and proof points for each major Rimes solution, organized by buyer persona and use case

• Live business case tools — at minimum an ROI calculator, a discovery guide, and a business case template — in active use by the Sales team

• Measurable pipeline influenced, with win rate and deal size tracked for VE-supported versus non-supported deals

• Observable seller behavior change: AEs and SEs leading discovery with business impact rather than feature walkthroughs

• Evidence of a different quality of executive conversation with CFOs, COOs, and CIOs — focused on outcomes, not products

• Value narratives in active use by AM and CS at renewal and in expansion conversations

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

• 6–10+ years of progressive experience in value engineering, value consulting, management consulting, strategic finance, or a senior commercial role with heavy analytical responsibility

• Demonstrated ability to build first-principles financial models and business cases that hold up to CFO and procurement scrutiny

• Experience running structured discovery sessions and executive workshops with C-suite buyers

• Track record of working across Sales, Product, Finance, and Marketing — influencing without direct authority

• Background in or strong knowledge of financial services, investment management, asset management, or enterprise financial data — or demonstrable experience in comparably complex regulated domains – investment banking or consulting backgrounds are a plus

• Experience at a company that has built or scaled a value-based selling capability, either as a practitioner or as someone who drove the change

• A degree in an analytical discipline — engineering, economics, finance, or similar; an MBA or other advanced degree preferred

Skills and Capabilities

• Financial modeling: fluent in Excel or equivalent; can independently build dynamic ROI, TCO, and cost-benefit models

• Executive presence: comfortable presenting business cases to CxOs and holding a room without a product demo as a crutch

• Structured thinking: approaches discovery, analysis, and storytelling with a clear, repeatable methodology

• Commercial instinct: understands what moves deals, not just what is analytically interesting

• Builder mindset: energized by starting from zero and creating assets that outlast individual deals

• Influence: earns the trust of experienced sellers and SEs through credibility and results rather than seniority

• Communication: writes and speaks with clarity; can distil complex business impact into a single executive-ready slide

• Methodology: familiar with MEDDPICC or an equivalent qualification framework and how to apply it in the field

• Self-direction: manages multiple concurrent deal engagements with rigor, balancing speed against analytical precision

• Capable of using AI tools to model and support analysis and action planning

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

Rimes is committed to promote the values of diversity and inclusion throughout the business. Whether it’s through recruitment, retention, career progression or training and development, we are committed to improving opportunities for people regardless of their background or circumstances.

Visit our Careers page to see our complete listings.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Escalations
jobs.description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are
 The Manager, Customer Support - Escalations is a hands-on, customer-facing leader responsible for HighLevel's Customer Escalations function and some of our most complex, sensitive, and high-impact customer experiences.You will lead a team of highly skilled Specialists focused first and foremost on taking ownership of difficult customer situations and driving them toward resolution. You will personally engage with customers when situations require management-level involvement, helping restore confidence, navigate ambiguity, and coordinate the right people across HighLevel to solve the problem.Beyond individual resolution, you will use th learnings to identify recurring customer friction, uncover systemic issues, and drive meaningful improvements across the broader customer journey.This is not a traditional support management role. You will move between direct customer conversations, people leadership, operational problem solving, and cross-functional influence. Success requires exceptional communication, strong business judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and a willingness to take ownership before every answer is known. 
What You'll Do
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team responsible for complex and high-visibility customer escalations.
Own the strategy, operating standards, performance, and continued development of the Customer Escalations function.
Serve as a senior escalation point for sensitive, complex, or business-critical customer situations.
Personally engage with customers in high-impact situations, taking ownership of difficult conversations and coordinating resolution across HighLevel.
Build a voice-first culture, prioritizing direct customer engagement when urgency, complexity, or trust requires it.
Establish scalable processes for managing escalations originating from executives, social media, online reviews, community channels, and other non-standard paths.
While this role sits within Customer Support, its mandate extends across the broader customer journey. You will work across Frontline Support, Escalations, Premium Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Billing, RevOps, and other functions to identify and address customer friction wherever it occurs.
Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations and operational improvements.
Partner across Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Billing, RevOps, and other functions to solve complex customer problems and improve cross-functional experiences.
Influence cross-functional teams to address recurring customer friction, clarify ownership, improve broken handoffs, and implement changes that reduce repeat escalations.
Lead targeted initiatives that address recurring customer friction and measure whether changes meaningfully improve customer outcomes.
Use data, automation, tooling, and process improvements to increase the effectiveness and scalability of Customer Advocacy.
What You'll Bring
8+ years of progressive experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Escalations, or a related customer-facing technology function, including meaningful leadership experience.
Demonstrated success in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.
Experience leading high-performing customer-facing professionals and owning or materially influencing a customer-facing function or program.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including confidence engaging customers, business owners, executives, and senior internal stakeholders.
Strong business judgment and experience navigating complex or high-risk customer situations.
Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, and turn customer insights into operational improvements.
Proven ability to influence and drive change across teams without direct authority.
Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to prioritize problems and measure outcomes.
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations and move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
Strong technical curiosity and the ability to develop deep proficiency in complex SaaS products and customer use cases.
Excellent prioritization skills with a strong bias toward action and ownership.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
What Success Looks Like
 Customer Advocacy becomes a trusted destination for HighLevel's most complex customer situations. Customers receive fast, confident ownership and direct human engagement, while leaders can trust the team to independently coordinate difficult situations across the organization.Beyond resolving individual escalations, you will ensure that what we learn from them leads to measurable improvements in processes, ownership, tooling, and the broader customer journey.Success is measured not only by how effectively we resolve escalations, but by how effectively we prevent the same customer problems from happening again.

What's in it for you?

• Competitive Salary
• Paid Time Off
• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, 401K
• Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
• Learning programs through our Academies
• Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
• Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities

• Maintain a positive service attitude at all times and be willing to help and advise guests with all questions and requests they may have.
• Deliver IRD orders/requests to the correct guests
• Respond to guest orders in a timely fashion

Your experience and skills include:

• Previous food and beverage experience is preferred
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Cash handling/transaction abilities

• Available to work varied shifts based on business demands including but not limited to mornings, late evenings, weekends and holidays.
• Ability to focus attention on guest needs, remaining calm and courteous at all times

Physical Aspects of Position (include but are not limited to):

• Constant standing and walking throughout shift
• Must be able to lift, carry, reach, push/pull at least 40lbs

Visa Requirements:

Employee Benefits:

Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. We commit to a future where diverse identities are celebrated, and equitable and inclusive practices are woven into the fabric of everything we do as an organization.

Fairmont Washington, D.C., Georgetown is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - AutoReview
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team building AutoReview—CoLab’s AI-powered capabilities for automating mechanical design review.

This is a people leadership role that requires real technical depth. You won’t need to be the engineer writing every solution, but you should understand software and web architecture well enough to pressure-test an approach, spot when an estimate doesn’t add up, and ask the question that changes the conversation.

You’ll work closely with Product to turn broad ideas into a roadmap the team can confidently execute. That includes making early calls on feasibility and scope, then giving engineers the context and autonomy to work through the details.

The technical problems are substantial: DFM checks, clash detection, BOM consolidation, clearance analysis, bulk AutoReview workflows, and increasingly, the intersection of 2D engineering data and machine learning.

Our Ideal Candidate

• You’ve managed engineers working on technically complex web applications—ideally involving geometry, 3D data, geometric processing, CAD, graphics, or adjacent domains.

• You care deeply about people and understand the technology they’re building. You stay connected enough to the work to identify risks early without becoming the person everyone depends on for every decision.

• This team is smart, motivated, and eager to move. Your job isn’t to manufacture ambition; it’s to provide clarity so that ambition is focused on the right problems.

• You’ll also help establish clearer, respectful boundaries between Engineering and Product ownership. If you enjoy building that kind of trusting partnership while navigating ambiguity, you’ll do well here.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and support the engineers responsible for Build AutoReview.

• Partner closely with Product to define priorities, assess feasibility, roughly scope initiatives, and build realistic timelines.

• Maintain enough technical context across projects to surface risks, dependencies, and questionable assumptions early.

• Help the team deliver major AutoReview initiatives, including DFM checks, assembly analysis, and bulk review workflows.

• Work across Engineering, Product, and the applied ML Team as AutoReview expands into areas where ownership and technical approaches are still evolving.

• Create focus when priorities change quickly because of new customer insight, technical developments, or advances in AI and ML.

• Build an environment where engineers have clear context, meaningful ownership, and the support to do excellent work.

Qualifications

• Experience managing software engineers in a technically complex product domain.

• Strong technical foundation in modern web application and software architecture.

• Experience with geometric processing, 3D/CAD applications, graphics, or similar technical systems is a strong asset.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with Product on roadmap planning, technical feasibility, estimation, and prioritization.

• Comfortable navigating evolving AI/ML technologies and understanding how they affect product and architecture decisions.

• Able to move quickly through new information, make thoughtful decisions, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

Extra Details

This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options. We offer comprehensive benefits and flexible vacation. This is a remote position open in Canada and the US.

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

 At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation https://www.linkedin.com/company/intel-corporation/, Canva https://www.linkedin.com/company/canva/, the United States Department of Defense https://www.linkedin.com/company/deptofdefense/, the United States Air Force https://www.linkedin.com/company/united-states-air-force/, ASICS https://www.linkedin.com/company/asics/, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.



We are looking for a data-driven Project Managers to lead our large-scale multilingual data collection and Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our AI development, orchestrating global teams of annotators and data specialists.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can optimize workflows for productivity, quality, and throughput, we want to hear from you

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


1. PROJECT MANAGEMENT

 - End-to-End Delivery: Manage the full lifecycle of AI data projects, from scoping and guidelines creation to data delivery and post-mortem analysis.

 - Pipeline Management: Oversee large-scale data pipelines for multilingual data collection (audio, text, image) and LLM evaluation (RLHF, SFT, ranking, and safety testing).


2. QUALITY ASSURANCE & PERFORMANCE MONITORING

 - KPI Tracking: rigorously monitor and report on key performance indicators, including:
   
   - Throughput: Volume of data processed per hour/day.
   
   - Quality: Accuracy scores, Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA), and gold-set performance.
   
   - Productivity: Cost-per-task and worker efficiency rates.

 - Quality Control: Run QA loops, root-cause analysis for quality dips, and corrective training for annotator pools.

 - Dashboards: Maintain dashboards to visualize project health and flag bottlenecks in real-time.


3. STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

 - Global Coordination: Manage relationships with data experts and crowd pools, ensuring adherence to SLAs regarding localized nuances and linguistic accuracy.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise with Applied AI Technical Ops teams. Translate technical requirements into clear, actionable guidelines for non-technical annotators.

 - Feedback Loops: Facilitate continuous feedback loops where data insights drive updates to annotation guidelines and model fine-tuning strategies.


QUALIFICATIONS


ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience: 3-5+ years of project management experience, specifically within AI/ML data operations.

 - LLM Knowledge: Strong understanding of LLM training processes (Pre-training, SFT, RLHF) and evaluation methodologies (Human-in-the-loop, red teaming).

 - Data Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; ability to write SQL queries to extract and analyze performance data.

 - Methodology: Proven track record using Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies to manage complex workflows.

 - Communication: Exceptional ability to write clear, unambiguous guidelines for multilingual audiences.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVES)

 - Multilingual: Fluency in a second language is highly desirable.

 - Technical Tools: Experience with data annotation platforms (e.g. Scale AI, Super Annotate) and project management tools (e.g. Jira).

 - Education: Background in ML Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science and Project Management training.




OUR STORY

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate.  As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.



LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.



With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.




OUR TECH

What sets our platform apart:

 - Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

 - Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

 - 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

 - Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review



LILT IN THE NEWS

 - Featured in The Software Report’s https://www.thesoftwarereport.com/the-top-100-software-companies-of-2024/ Top 100 Software Companies!

 - LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List https://labs.lilt.com/lilt-listed-on-the-2024-inc-5000.

 - LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents https://patents.justia.com/inventor/john-sturdy-denero that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

 - Check out all our news on our website https://lilt.com/news.

jobs.title: Area Engineering Analyst
jobs.description:
The Area Engineering Analyst will:

Is responsible for leading all engineering, maintenance, and reliability activities within the Pre-Cured Tread (PCT) Department to ensure safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of production equipment. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve Preventive Maintenance (PM) and Predictive Maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and availability. Establish, maintain, and optimize spare parts inventories, ensuring critical spare parts are identified, available, and properly managed to support operational reliability. Supervise and coordinate maintenance technician activities within the assigned area, including scheduling work and workforce development. Lead routine reliability team meetings and drive reliability improvement initiatives throughout the department. Monitor, analyze, and report maintenance performance (MTTR, MTBF, R&M Downtime, Spare Parts Cost and Outside Service Cost. Identify and execute opportunities for continuous improvement in equipment performance, maintenance efficiency, and overall operational reliability.

The Area Engineering Analyst works closely with production, quality and other supporting plant teams to minimize downtime, optimize equipment performance, improve maintenance effectiveness, and ensure compliance with Environmental, Safety, and Health (ESH) requirements. This role requires strong analytical and organizational skills, a hands-on approach to problem solving, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• 1. Lead and continuously improve preventive, predictive, and reliability maintenance programs to maximize equipment availability and performance.
• Plan, schedule, and coordinate maintenance activities and resources to minimize downtime and support production objectives (PMs)
• Supervise and support maintenance technicians, including work scheduling, technical guidance, and workforce development.
• Manage spare parts inventory and critical spare strategies to ensure equipment reliability and maintenance readiness.
• Lead reliability initiatives, including reliability meetings, equipment performance analysis, and continuous improvement activities.
• Conduct root cause analyses of equipment and process failures and implement effective corrective actions and engineering solutions.
• Provide technical expertise and troubleshooting support for mechanical, electrical, automation, and control systems, including Siemens PLC and TIA Portal applications.

jobs.title: Mindshare: Manager, Social Media, Iraq
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

The Social Media Manager will lead the development, execution, and optimization of advanced social media strategies designed to strengthen clients’ brand presence, drive meaningful engagement, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Working at the intersection of creativity, media, and data, this role requires a strategic, performance-oriented thinker with strong hands-on expertise across paid and organic social ecosystems. You will translate brand and business objectives into impactful social strategies, manage always-on social presence, execute campaigns, and optimize performance through analytics-driven decision-making.

Operating across high-profile accounts, you will balance strategic leadership with operational excellence; guiding campaign direction, driving innovation, overseeing performance, and mentoring junior team members. This role goes beyond publishing content: you will actively shape how brands show up within culture, conversations, and digital ecosystems. Your work will directly influence brand perception, audience engagement, and performance outcomes, contributing to brand growth, media effectiveness, and business impact within an integrated communications framework.

• Develop and evolve comprehensive social media strategies aligned with client business objectives, marketing priorities, and integrated communication, media, and performance goals.

• Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of paid and organic social initiatives across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

• Oversee full-funnel social planning, including audience strategy, channel roles, creative input, media allocation, and performance optimization.

• Plan and oversee social content calendars and campaigns, ensuring alignment with brand priorities, seasonal moments, and marketing initiatives, while maintaining consistency, relevance, and brand integrity in day-to-day publishing across platforms.

• Manage end-to-end campaign workflows, including briefing, setup, QA, pacing, optimization, reporting, and post-campaign analysis.

• Own budget management, forecasting, and financial tracking to ensure efficient and effective media investment.

• Drive community management by fostering meaningful interactions, ensuring audiences receive timely, brand-appropriate responses, and strengthening audience relationships.

• Actively monitor social trends, platform updates, and cultural conversations to identify opportunities for brand participation, relevance, innovation, and platform testing that support continuous account growth.

• Utilize social listening tools to monitor brand sentiment, audience conversations, competitor activity, industry trends, and emerging topics, identifying opportunities, risks, and actionable insights that inform content strategies, community management, campaign optimization, and overall brand positioning.

• Leverage analytics and reporting tools to evaluate content and campaign performance, translating findings into actionable, data-driven insights and strategic recommendations that refine content, messaging, and platform approaches and improve efficiency, audience impact, ROI, and campaign effectiveness.

• Confidently present strategies, performance results, and growth opportunities to clients and senior stakeholders.

• Mentor and support junior team members, ensuring high-quality execution and capability development.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (media, strategy, analytics, creative, performance, and client servicing and leadership) to ensure cohesive storytelling, channel alignment, and integrated, performance-driven solutions.

Skills and Experience

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. Success in this role requires embracing WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

• Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire Transformational Creativity

• Create an Open Environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences while Cultivating Trust

• Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth, Innovation, and Enterprise Collaboration

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.

• 4–6+ years of experience in social media strategy, planning, and activation, preferably within a media agency or integrated marketing environment.

• Strong expertise across major social platforms, including Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

• Strong knowledge of digital media and integrated marketing channels, with a deep understanding of all media, particularly digital platforms.

• Up-to-date knowledge of current social media trends and platform updates.

• Proven ability to manage campaigns, budgets, and performance optimization initiatives.

• Advanced knowledge of social analytics, measurement frameworks, attribution models, and reporting tools, with hands-on experience using social publishing and listening tools.

• Experience in community management, including audience engagement, conversation management, and timely, brand-aligned responses.

• Fluent in English and Arabic, both written and spoken.

• Strong client management, storytelling, and presentation skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead projects, manage multiple workstreams, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

• Experience mentoring, guiding, or overseeing junior team members.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, organizational, and analytical skills.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events.

Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Environmental Engineer - 2 years minimum experience
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an Environmental Engineer II to be based out of our Seattle, Washington office. The successful candidate will be a self-motivated individual with a strong background in environmental engineering and a successful work history in environmental investigations (groundwater, soil vapor, and soil sampling) and environmental site remediation of impacted sites, as well as strong task management and technical report writing skills.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Remediation system operation and maintenance.

• Gather and correlate basic engineering data using established and well-defined procedures.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to entry-level engineers.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop solutions to environmental challenges using established methods and innovative approaches.
• Perform routine engineering assignments involving calculations and technical evaluations.
• Execute work in accordance with agreed-upon budgets and schedules with minimal supervision.
• Support environmental investigation and remediation projects throughout Washington and the Pacific Northwest region.
• Conduct field work to assist with remediation system operations, maintenance, monitoring, and environmental sampling activities.
• Qualified candidates must be comfortable working in the field and traveling to project sites as needed.

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering or a related field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience.
• Valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
• Ability to successfully pass a background check.
• Due to the nature of work and project sites, U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent Resident status is required. Sponsorship now or in the future is not available.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with soil and groundwater remediation systems.
• Willingness to perform field work, including oversight of contractors and subcontractors.
• Strong technical report writing skills and the ability to develop engineering design specifications.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other standard engineering software applications.
• Master's degree in Environmental Engineering or a related field.
• Four (4) years of relevant environmental consulting or engineering experience.
• Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Washington State or the ability to obtain within six (6) months of hire; Oregon P.E. registration is considered a plus.
• 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER certification and current 8-hour annual refresher.
• Positive attitude, strong communication skills, willingness to mentor junior staff, and commitment to workplace health and safety.
• Self-motivated individual who can work independently and effectively communicate project status to project managers and clients.
• Ability to proactively engage with AECOM staff, subcontractors, clients, and regulatory stakeholders.
• Familiarity with Washington State Department of Ecology cleanup programs and guidance, including MTCA regulations; experience with Oregon DEQ and other Pacific Northwest regulatory frameworks is a plus.
• Ability to frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds of field equipment with assistance.
• Ability to safely operate a full-size pickup truck and travel to project sites throughout the Pacific Northwest.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
