jobs.title: Analytics Senior Lead
jobs.description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

At PMG, our Analytics team is at the heart of turning data into strategic insights that fuel smarter marketing, media, and business decisions. We go beyond surface-level metrics to uncover trends, optimize performance, and provide clarity that helps brands connect with their audiences in more meaningful ways.

You’ll collaborate with media strategists, data engineers, creative teams, and business leaders, using analytics to evaluate marketing effectiveness, refine campaign strategies, and drive business impact. Whether it’s building dynamic dashboards, designing attribution models, conducting deep-dive data analysis, or leveraging predictive insights, your expertise will help brands make data-informed decisions with confidence.

Beyond reporting, you’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of measurement, experiment with emerging analytics methodologies, and explore AI-driven solutions to enhance marketing performance. You’ll play a key role in testing new approaches, refining best practices, and shaping how brands define success in an ever-evolving digital landscape. At PMG, we don’t just analyze data—we use it to challenge assumptions, drive innovation, and shape the future of media and advertising.

As a Senior Lead in Analytics, if you’re passionate about turning complex data into actionable insights, solving real-world marketing challenges with analytics, and helping brands make smarter, data-driven decisions, this is the place to make an impact.

What You Will Be Doing

• From the intake process to client delivery, manage the analytics request process ensuring an output of high quality, on-time deliverables.

• Support the development and maintenance of custom analytics solutions, from data sourcing to SQL to data visualization, while managing requests and troubleshooting issues.

• Create clear, comprehensive media reporting tying performance to customer actions and business KPIs for technical and non-technical audiences, thereby empowering teams and clients to act with confidence.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Media, Client Strategy, Data Science, Engineering—to design, implement and validate measurement strategies tailored to client objectives.

• Mentor others within data visualization and data engineering, fostering their growth while holding them accountable for delivering high-quality work.

• Stay ahead marketing measurement trends, tools, and best practices, contributing to PMG’s thought leadership and driving innovation

What You Will Bring

• 5+ years of experience in analytics (3+ years of which must be marketing analytics related), with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. Masters degree in a subdomain of Analytics or Data Science preferred.

• Background in financial services a plus

• Hands-on experience with data warehousing solutions such as Amazon Redshift, BigQuery and Snowflake to implement and manage ETL pipelines (dbt) to streamline data workflows and ensure data integrity, accuracy and comprehensiveness.

• Expertise in SQL for complex data manipulation, optimization, and deriving proactive business insights from large-scale datasets.

• Experience working with ad tech and digital marketing data, with a deep understanding of how data drives decision-making across channels.

• Strong working knowledge of marketing measurement frameworks, including media mix modeling, lift testing, and incrementality testing.

• Advanced proficiency in using visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker to build scalable, self-serve dashboards and performance reports.

• Strong working knowledge of Python or R to conduct advanced analysis, automate workflows, and support statistical modeling when needed.

• Proven ability to build strong stakeholder relationships in a fast paced environment while leading strategic analytics projects, especially measurement frameworks, and synthesize insights into clear recommendations for individuals at all tiers of the organization.

• Partner across functions—including product, media, engineering, analytics, and strategy—to influence KPIs, business planning, and campaign optimization.

• Experience with Data Clean Rooms is a plus

• A proactive approach to improving data quality, consistency, and accessibility across teams and tools.

• A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.

• A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by leading by example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

• Professional Development: Take advantage of our learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support.

• Generous Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off and holiday allowances to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

• Parental Leave: We provide paid parental leave to support your family during important life events.

• Retirement & Pension Plans: Plan for your future with competitive retirement or pension programs, including contribution matching.

• Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility benefits for all team members and their spouses.

• Healthcare: Coverage and support for everyday medical expenses and routine care, tailored by geography.

• Pet Insurance: Protect your pet's health and your finances.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being.

• Commuter Benefits: Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available.

• Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus.

• Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local communities.

• AI Enterprise License: Access AI Enterprise accounts and participate in weekly AI training sessions to empower and ensure AI safety.

Benefits vary by country, location, and geography to reflect local laws, norms, and expectations.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: On Holiday Support Agent
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.



About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.



The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.



Your day-to-day:

 - Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

 - Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

 - Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

 - Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

 - Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

 - Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

 - Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

 - Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

 - Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

 - Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

 - Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

 - Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments
   

Your skillset:

 - Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

 - A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

 - Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

 - Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

 - Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

 - Excellent organisation and attention to detail

 - Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

 - A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures
   

The interview journey:

 1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

 2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes
    

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

 - Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

 - 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

 - Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers



At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

jobs.title: Sr. Launch Engineer - Interiors & Exteriors
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly Sr. Launch Engineer to support vehicle launch, production ramp-up, and ongoing manufacturing operations. This role serves as the primary link between Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Suppliers, and Program Management to ensure interior and exterior systems are delivered with exceptional quality, craftsmanship, and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with strong technical expertise, exceptional problem-solving skills, and a passion for execution. This position requires a high level of ownership, resilience, and willingness to go above and beyond to resolve issues and achieve program milestones.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead launch and production support activities for vehicle interior and exterior systems.

• Support prototype, pilot, pre-production, and Start of Production (SOP) builds.

• Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality, fit and finish, gap and flush, craftsmanship, manufacturing, and supplier-related issues.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and Design Engineering teams to ensure successful vehicle launches.

• Track, prioritize, and drive closure of launch issues while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.

• Support process improvements focused on quality, cost, delivery, and customer satisfaction.

• Act as the on-site engineering representative during critical launch activities and production escalations.

Skills

• Strong technical aptitude and a relentless problem-solving mentality.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions.

• High level of ownership, accountability, and urgency.

• Willingness to work hands-on in a manufacturing environment and support critical launch activities as needed.

• Ability to work effectively with global engineering teams, including teams based in the United States. This requires flexibility to participate in early-morning or evening meetings outside normal working hours when business needs require.

• Self-motivated, resilient, and committed to doing what it takes to deliver world-class products and launch success.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.

• 5+ years of automotive engineering experience in Interiors, Exteriors, Vehicle Integration, Manufacturing, Quality, or Launch Engineering.

• Strong understanding of automotive products, manufacturing processes, and engineering fundamentals.

• Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, FMEA, or similar tools.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional reports, and technical data.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting vehicle launches, pilot builds, or manufacturing ramp-ups.

• Experience in development and launching systems in interior or exterior systems (concept to launch).

• Technical expertise in automotive interior and/or exterior systems.

• Experience working directly with suppliers, manufacturing plants, and cross-functional engineering teams.

• Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, and automotive quality systems.

• Experience in using 3DX and CATIA

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. jobs.title: Country Director
jobs.description:

Find your home in out-of-home - find your people at Vistar.

By combining our DOOH expertise with T-Mobile’s unique customer insights and expansive omnichannel capabilities, we’re creating new opportunities to innovate at scale and make a meaningful impact on the future of out-of-home media.

As the pioneer in OOH technology, we build solutions that help brands find their audience in the right place at the right time, on digital signage networks around the corner, or around the world.

About us: Vistar Media is the home of out-of-home (OOH). As a global ad tech company and the world's largest digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising marketplace, we offer technology designed to make buying and selling OOH media easier. Our goal is simple: to help the world's marketers leverage OOH's unique ability to motivate and delight. From strategic partnerships with major media owner networks to executing impactful campaigns with renowned global brands such as Nestlé, Porsche, Target, and Levi's, our team is filled with passionate, innovative, and collaborative problem solvers, engaging and entertaining consumers like you in the real world. Find your home in out-of-home - find your people at Vistar.

About the role: As we continue our expansion of the APAC market, we are looking for a Country Manager to launch and lead the market in Thailand. We are looking for a well connected sales leader with expert-level knowledge of programmatic to help grow the business, plan the GTM strategy, and eventually build a high-performing team, with the ultimate goal of driving revenue across the region.

What you’ll do:

• Develop and implement a sales strategy to extract sales opportunities both with agencies/brands and media owners to position Vistar Media in Thailand

• Establish Vistar’s value proposition based on market needs and Vistar’s core capabilities

• Directly drive revenue across holding companies, agencies, and brands across Thailand

• Strengthen Vistar’s product market fit by collaborating closely with Vistar’s solution development teams

• Develop and track key sales performance metrics with accountability for driving results

• Implement a go-to-market strategy, manage and optimize a win-win collaboration with the trading departments of larger agencies

• Understand customers’ demand, develop concepts, calculations, and proposals for media owners, and manage the relationship with technology partners

• As the market grows, establish and manage a high performing team in the region

• Represent the company in assigned events and other sales activities such as trade shows, speeches, interviews, etc.

What experience we’re looking for:

• Excellent understanding of digital advertising technology and trading; programmatic, mobile, audio, data, currency tracking, and attribution

• Extensive experience in solutions sales in digital advertising

• Experience launching and growing a business from the ground up in Thailand

• A strong network of direct client and agency relationships, and a network of contacts across the industry in Thailand

• Proven ability to build client relationships at all levels of seniority, demonstrating retention and growth strategies

• Demonstrable knowledge of OOH media and advertising

• Experience in negotiating contracts and trading agreements, ensuring fulfillment of these deals

• At least 8 years of experience in a sales leadership role with another DSP or advertising technology company

Who you are:

• Entrepreneurial mindset, the determination to succeed, and grow a small business unit within an international support framework

• Eager to put skin in the game to maximize the company’s (as well as your own) returns

• You have experience building a region and teams from scratch

• Willingness to be part of an international company with huge ambitions to grow our global presence

• Autonomous, able to drive the development of new business and sales engagement independently

• Calm under pressure, and patient in communicating with people of all backgrounds

If you’re ambitious, highly driven, and interested in making an impact, Vistar is the place for you. Apply to join our team… we’ll see you out there.

Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

jobs.title: (Senior) Environmental Due Diligence Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced (Senior) Environmental Due Diligence Consultant to join our New Jersey environmental team. The successful candidate will support and manage environmental due diligence, site investigation, and remediation projects for commercial, industrial, and transactional clients throughout New Jersey. This role is ideal for a professional with 3-5 years of experience who has developed strong technical expertise in ASTM Phase I Environmental Site Assessments, NJDEP site remediation requirements, and environmental transaction support.

The successful candidate will work directly with Project Managers and Licensed Site Remediation Professionals (LSRPs) while taking increasing ownership of client relationships, project execution, report preparation, and regulatory coordination.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead and manage environmental due diligence projects for commercial, industrial, lending, and real estate transactions, including the preparation and review of ASTM-compliant Phase I Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs).
• Manage and execute environmental site investigations and remediation projects in accordance with NJDEP regulations and Technical Requirements for Site Remediation.
• Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for clients, providing technical guidance, project updates, and practical recommendations regarding environmental liabilities and risk management.
• Plan, coordinate, and oversee field investigation and remediation activities, including soil, groundwater, and vapor intrusion assessments.
• Evaluate environmental data, identify potential risks and regulatory obligations, and develop technically sound recommendations for clients and project teams.
• Prepare and review technical reports and regulatory submissions, including Preliminary Assessment Reports (PARs), Site Investigation Reports (SIRs), Remedial Investigation Reports (RIRs), Remedial Action Workplans (RAWs), Remedial Action Reports (RARs), and permit applications.
• Support Project Managers and Licensed Site Remediation Professionals (LSRPs) in project strategy, regulatory negotiations, and client-facing meetings.
• Coordinate subcontractors, laboratories, drilling contractors, and other project resources to ensure quality, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of technical quality, responsiveness, and client service.
• Support business development efforts through proposal preparation, client relationship management, networking, and identification of new project opportunities.
• Mentor junior staff and provide technical guidance to support professional development and project delivery excellence.
• Ensure compliance with company health and safety policies, environmental regulations, and quality management procedures.

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Geology, Environmental Science, Engineering, Biology, or a related scientific discipline.
• 3-5 years of experience performing environmental due diligence, site investigations, and remediation projects in New Jersey.
• Demo associated guidance documents.
• Experience supporting environmental investigations and remediation projects, including soil, groundwater, and vapor intrusion assessments.
• Working knowledge of key NJDEP deliverables, including PARs, SIRs, RIRs, RAWs, RARs, and permit applications.
• Experience coordinating field activities, subcontractors, laboratories, and data management efforts.
• Ability to evaluate environmental data and provide technical recommendations to Project Managers and LSRPs.
• Strong project management, organizational, and client communication skills.
• 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER certification.
• Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.

Preferred

• Experience managing multiple due diligence and remediation projects simultaneously.
• Existing relationships with commercial real estate, legal, lending, or development clients.
• Professional Geologist (PG), Licensed Site Remediation Professional (LSRP), or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) credentials, or progress toward obtaining professional licensure.
• Experience mentoring junior staff and supporting proposal development and business development initiatives.

Physical and Mental Job Qualifications

• Most duties performed on feet.
• Able to carry equipment, as much as 30lbs unassisted.
• Push or pull items.
• Able to reach above head.
• Able to bend at the knee.
• Able to climb ladders to reach high areas.
• Able to wear a self-contained breathing apparatus.
• Able to squat, kneel or crouch in confined spaces when necessary.
• Able to detect burning sensations on skin etc.
• Vision must be correctable to at least 20:40 with ability to distinguish colors with good depth perception and peripheral vision.

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

• Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
• Generous PTO Policy

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $65,000 - $95,000. Any offered salary range is based on a wide array of factors including but not limited to skillset, experience, training, location, scope of role, management responsibility, etc.

jobs.title: Employee Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Foley's Boston office is growing, and we're looking for an organized, personable Employee Experience Coordinator to be the primary point of contact for everything happening in the office and to support our People team. This is a full-time, hybrid role, onsite in Boston Tuesday through Thursday at minimum.

You'll own the day-to-day of the office (vendors, ordering, maintenance, and anyone walking through the door), lead in-office event planning and catering, and partner closely with the People team on leadership meeting coordination, travel, and administrative support spanning candidate experience, onboarding, and scheduling. We're looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about making Foley a great place to work, enjoys variety, and takes ownership of the details.

What you'll do

Office & Vendor Management

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for all office vendors (snack and beverage suppliers, cleaning, maintenance, building management, and other service providers), coordinating deliveries, service visits, invoices, and renewals

 - Manage recurring and ad hoc ordering for office supplies, snacks, beverages, and kitchen inventory

 - Coordinate facilities and maintenance requests with building management, and keep common areas, kitchen, and huddle/conference rooms stocked, tidy, and functional

 - Receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and manage outgoing mail and shipments

Reception & Guest Experience

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for anyone visiting the office, greeting and registering guests and managing the front desk during office hours

 - Own badge and key fob management for employees and guests, including issuing, deactivating, and troubleshooting building access

 - Answer general employee questions about the office and space

 - Maintain and administer the desk and room booking software (e.g., Kadence), including user setup, configuration, and troubleshooting

Event Planning & Catering

 - Own planning and execution of in-office events, team lunches, celebrations, and offsites hosted in the Boston office

 - Manage catering orders and vendor coordination for events, including setup and breakdown

People Team Support

 - Assist the People team with leadership meeting coordination, including scheduling, logistics, and materials preparation

 - Coordinate travel arrangements for leadership and other team members as needed

 - Support candidate experience during the hiring process, including interview scheduling and day-of coordination

 - Assist with onboarding logistics for new hires, including first-day setup and coordination with the People team

 - Partner with the IT team on onboarding (equipment setup, system access) and day-to-day employee tech support needs

 - Support employee recognition and gifting programs, including birthdays, work anniversaries, and other milestone moments

 - Provide general administrative and scheduling support to the People team as needed

Who you are

 - 1 to 3 years of experience in an office management, office coordination, administrative, or HR/People support role

 - Comfortable managing multiple vendors, stakeholders, and priorities independently

 - Strong organizational skills and follow-through on recurring tasks (ordering, invoicing, scheduling)

 - Clear, friendly communication for a front-facing role, with both employees and outside visitors

 - Discretion in handling confidential or sensitive information, such as candidate and employee details

 - Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)

Nice to have

 - Prior experience administering a desk/room booking platform (e.g., Kadence) or similar workplace software

 - Experience supporting HR or People team functions, such as onboarding or interview scheduling

 - Experience coordinating travel arrangements

 - Comfortable lifting and moving light office and event supplies (up to approximately 25 lbs)

You might thrive in this role if you...

 - Like being the go-to person who makes an office feel put together and welcoming

 - Enjoy juggling different types of work across a single day, from vendor calls to event setup to calendar coordination

 - Take initiative on small fixes without waiting to be asked

 - Build good relationships with vendors, building staff, and colleagues across the company

 - Care about the details that make someone's first day, an interview, or a team event go smoothly

Location: This role is based in our Boston office located in Seaport. This is a full-time, hybrid role, onsite Tuesday through Thursday at minimum, with flexibility on remaining days.


ABOUT US

At Foley, we’re reimagining how safety-sensitive industries hire, stay compliant, and manage risk. We’ve evolved into a modern SaaS company with an all-in-one, AI-ready platform that helps transportation, construction, distribution, and utility businesses operate faster, smarter, and safer.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for curious, strategic thinkers who thrive in complexity, are motivated by making an impact, and want to join a team that’s passionate about building great products and supporting customers. jobs.title: Lead of Growth Analytics
jobs.description:
Who Are We?
Welltech is a global wellness technology company with Ukrainian roots. Our mission is to build and scale wellness apps globally through state-of-the-art, tech-driven performance marketing.

We are one of the most established players in the wellness app space, and we are accelerating. Over 25.5 million people across the world use our apps — Muscle Booster, Yoga-Go, and WalkFit — to build healthier habits, move more, and feel better every day. Every subscription represents a real person making a real change in their life, and we take that seriously.

With 500+ people across hubs in Cyprus, Ukraine, Poland, Spain, and the UK, we combine the scale of a market leader and the drive of a team that's just getting

We are looking for a Lead of Growth Analytics to own the end-to-end experimentation engine, pricing mechanics, and app funnel optimization. In this role, you will lead a dedicated team of analysts, working at the intersection of product monetization, user acquisition, and decision science. You will establish rigorous experimentation frameworks (including A/B/N testing, pricing elasticity, and statistical validation), leverage modern experimentation platforms like EPPO, and integrate AI-augmented workflows to maximize overall growth and customer lifetime value.

Main Responsibilities

 - Team Leadership & Strategy: Build, mentor, and direct a high-performing growth analytics team. Cultivate an environment that supports data-driven decision-making with a bias for action and clear accountability.

 - App Funnel & Conversion Optimization: Own the analytics for onboarding flows and paywalls. Identify conversion bottlenecks and turn user behavior data into high-impact growth hypotheses.

 - Pricing & Monetization Experiments: Design, execute, and analyze pricing experiments (tariffs, localized pricing, paywall variants, and upsell offers) to optimize conversion rates and average revenue per user (ARPU).

 - Experimentation Framework & Tooling: Establish standardized experimentation methodologies across the company. Define sample sizes, guardrail metrics, and statistical boundaries (sequential testing, Bayesian vs. Frequentist approaches).

 - AI & Workflow Automation: Implement AI tools and LLM-assisted workflows within the analytics process to accelerate exploratory data analysis, reporting, and automated anomaly detection.

 - Executive Reporting & Insights: Synthesize complex experiment outcomes into actionable recommendations for C-suite, Product, and Marketing leaders.

Required Skills and Experience

 - Leadership: Proven, successful managerial experience leading growth or product analytics teams in digital or mobile app environments.

 - Funnel & Pricing Analytics: Deep hands-on experience with app funnel analysis, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and pricing mechanics for B2C subscription or freemium products.

 - Experimentation Expertise: Strong mastery of A/B testing methodologies, statistical hypothesis testing, variance reduction (CUPED), and experimental design.

 - Technical & SQL Proficiency: Strong hands-on SQL skills to query, model, and verify data independently; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.

 - Data Stack & Tools: Experience working with modern product analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Looker, Tableau) and experimentation tools.

 - AI Literacy: Active user of AI/GenAI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) to automate daily analytics tasks and streamline research workflows.

 - Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex statistical outcomes into clear commercial insights for cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have

 - Eppo Platform Experience: Direct experience with EPPO or similar modern feature-flagging and automated experimentation platforms.

 - Ad Tech & Signal Knowledge: Familiarity with conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions), server-side tracking, and MMPs (AppsFlyer/Adjust).

 - Incrementality & Causal Inference: Knowledge of geo-lift tests, holdout groups, and causal inference methods (Synthetic Controls, CausalImpact).Subscription Business Models: Experience in high-growth mobile subscription apps (Health & Fitness, Utility, EdTech).

Santander is a global leader and innovator in the financial services industry and is evolving from a high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization. Our people are at the heart of this journey and together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.  This is more than a strategic shift.  It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

The Difference You Make:

The Agency Mortgage-Backed Securities (“MBS”) Trading Vice President is responsible for market-making, risk management, trade execution, and revenue generation across Agency MBS products. The role requires deep knowledge of mortgage markets, strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, and the ability to make timely trading decisions in a fast-paced, risk-controlled environment.

You will partner closely with Institutional Sales, Research, Structuring, Operations, Finance, Technology, Risk, and Compliance to deliver liquidity, market insights, and trade ideas to institutional clients while managing the firm’s positions in accordance with established risk limits and regulatory requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

• Make markets and execute transactions across Agency MBS products, including To-Be-Announced securities, specified pools, pass-through securities, and related mortgage products.
• Manage trading positions, market risk, basis risk, convexity risk, prepayment exposure, and daily profit and loss within approved limits.
• Price securities and evaluate relative-value opportunities using market data, prepayment assumptions, yield and spread analysis, option-adjusted spread analysis, and other mortgage analytics.

• Monitor macroeconomic developments, interest-rate movements, Federal Reserve activity, housing-market trends, mortgage origination dynamics, and regulatory developments that may affect Agency MBS valuations.

jobs.title: Senior Client Solutions Manager, Sports Goods and Merchandise Influencer Marketing (Remote - US, EST hours)
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

💡 The role in a nutshell

You own a portfolio of Kyra's largest enterprise accounts (multi-million-dollar brand partnerships) and you're measured on whether they grow. Retention, expansion, and Net Revenue Retention are your scoreboard.


💡 What You'll Own

This is a commercial role, not a delivery one. You keep enterprise clients, grow them, and run delivery cleanly enough that growth is never at risk.

 - Revenue. You carry an NRR target across your book. You protect it, and you grow it.

 - The relationship. You're the trusted strategic partner to senior brand-side stakeholders, not the campaign contact.

 - The system. You're the connective tissue between Sales, Strategy, Campaigns, Paid, and Product, and you keep them aligned and operating efficiently.

 - The early warning. When something drifts (performance, scope, relationship, or margin) you see it two quarters out and fix it before it becomes a problem. No surprises. No scrambling. Just steady, commercial ownership.

 - The standard. You lead a pod of CSMs and/or Junior CSMs. Their performance and their client work is yours to elevate.
   

🎯 Lead the Relationship

Own client relationships across launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programs. Multi-thread across teams. Build trust. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.


📈 Turn Insight into Strategy

Translate data into clear, actionable plans. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

🤖 AI-First 
You'll be expected to use AI daily to compress reporting, model renewals, prep upsells, and synthesise client data, so you can buy back time for the things that add value, like managing the relationship.


🔍 Own Delivery End-to-End

Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across seeding, paid, and integrated campaigns. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.


📊 Protect & Grow Revenue

Manage renewal timelines. Identify upsell opportunities. Drive Net Revenue Retention. Be able to speak confidently about account growth with real numbers.


💾 Use Data to Improve What's Next

Forecast performance. Optimise mid-campaign. Apply learnings to the next program. Reporting informs decisions; it's not a recap.


🛡️ Keep the System Tight

Keep tracking clean. Watch team capacity. Fix what's inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn't get lost.


What We're Looking For

 - We're looking for someone who has:

 - 6+ years in influencer or creator marketing, with real time on large or enterprise accounts

 - Hands-on campaign fluency, with genuine command of Meta and TikTok

 - A track record of account growth and retention you can quantify, so bring the numbers

 - You've been measured against revenue, retention, or NRR before, and you know what moved them

 - Direct people-leadership experience. You've run 1:1s, managed workload, and lifted the performance of people you're responsible for

 - AI-native. You build AI tools into your daily work for faster execution, sharper insight, and smarter workflows

 - You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the revenue impact of the accounts you've managed.
   

Traits That Matter

Curious. Commercially aware. Direct. Adaptable. Strong at building trust. Open to feedback. You don't avoid hard conversations. You don't wait for issues to escalate. You don't need constant direction.


What Success Looks Like

6 months in: renewals are planned early, NRR targets are on track, expansion opportunities are clearly mapped, delivery runs smoothly, and leadership trusts your forecast.


Benefits

🌎 Remote-first, so you can work from wherever you do your best work 
🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year 
📚 Growth: Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills 
💰 Rewards: Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work
🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members


👉 Tips for Application

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Biodiversity & Conservation Specialist
jobs.description:
Work location: Sines

About the Role

The Biodiversity & Conservation Specialist is Start Campus’ ecological Specialist, based at the SINES DC campus. The role is field-based, with regular surveying and monitoring, and covers the technical reports, project deliverables and practical guidance that the teams designing, building and operating Start Campus sites rely on.

With the biodiversity plan and commitments already largely defined, the priority is execution: delivering specific projects on the ground and documenting the results. The role also shapes how the plan develops as field data comes in and as the sites and regulation change.

Working closely with internal teams, environmental consultants, contractors, regulators and local stakeholders, the Biodiversity & Conservation Specialist will help minimise ecological impacts, identify opportunities for habitat enhancement and support the organisation’s wider nature-related commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Field survey and monitoring

• Provide technical oversight of field monitoring activities for the fauna and flora components, including species-specific monitoring, and process the resulting field and habitat mapping data in GIS.

• Run the biodiversity monitoring programmes during the construction and operational phases.

• Act as the reference ecologist on site: pre-construction checks, supervision of vegetation clearance and direct advice to construction management and planning.

• Monitor and track the mitigation, restoration and enhancement measures already in place, and flag possible ecological constraints early.

• Respond to ecological incidents and unexpected finds on site, coordinating with the authorities where required.

Technical reporting and compliance

• Prepare monitoring reports, field reports and technical notes for regulator and third-party review.

• Analyse monitoring data and turn it into clear findings and recommendations.

• Keep survey records, species and habitat inventories, monitoring results and GIS layers up to date and ready for audit.

• Track biodiversity commitments, licence conditions and mitigation measures, and report progress against them.

• Verify compliance with Portuguese and European nature conservation legislation, and provide technical input to licensing and permitting.

Project execution and technical coordination

• Execute specific biodiversity projects in habitat restoration, native planting, invasive species control, species protection measures and monitoring programmes, from scope to close-out, under overall project coordination.

• Translate ecological requirements into practical projects, specifications and contractor requirements.

• Handle the process side of project coordination: timelines, documentation, procurement steps, approvals and the flow of information between the parties involved.

• Develop and deliver environmental awareness initiatives across the campus and with the surrounding community.

• Coordinate ecological consultants and contractors on scope, field access, deliverables and quality, and review external reports critically.

• Provide biodiversity input into design reviews, method statements and construction planning, working alongside Design & Delivery, Construction, Operations, Legal and Procurement.

• Act as technical interface with environmental authorities, the municipality, academic institutions and conservation organisations, and support site inspections and audits.

Technical strategy and improvement

• Contribute to the biodiversity strategy, targets and action plans.

• Proactively identify biodiversity-related risks and opportunities across current and future developments.

• Follow developments in biodiversity regulation, monitoring methods and good practice, and bring what is useful into how the campus is built and run.

• Promote good field practice among employees and contractors.

• Identify partnerships and research collaborations relevant to Start Campus’ conservation work.

jobs.title: Customer Success Intern

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible application programming interfaces (APIs) and tools that help developers create products on crypto infrastructure.

Privy provides the abstraction and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across blockchain networks, third-party providers, and Stripe products such as Treasury and Link. We solve complex technical problems while using Stripe’s global reach to support customers including Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo. Our technology powers experiences for both mainstream users and crypto-native audiences.

Learn more: [Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone]

About the team

The Account Executive, Product team connects Privy’s technology with companies building new products across fintech and crypto. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners to understand prospective customers’ needs, shape technical and commercial solutions, and turn market insights into product and sales strategy. Its focus includes priority segments such as neobanking, payments, and brokerages.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive you’ll own complex enterprise sales cycles and help expand Privy’s work with companies across fintech and crypto. You’ll build relationships with senior commercial and technical stakeholders, develop new opportunities, and help refine Privy’s enterprise sales approach. You’ll also contribute to Privy’s global growth strategy and represent the company at industry events.

Responsibilities

• Partner with the Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) to build and close a strong pipeline of enterprise prospects.

• Develop and test outbound campaigns based on market and customer feedback.

• Build deep expertise in Privy’s products and lead discovery calls with fintech prospects to understand their needs and explain Privy’s value.

• Contribute to the Go-to-Market team’s strategy across North America and other global markets, including Latin America, Asia, and Africa.

Who you are

Minimum requirements

• Ability to lead discovery conversations with technical buyers, including chief technology officers and product leaders.

• Familiarity with crypto infrastructure, such as stablecoins, on-ramps and off-ramps, wallets, and custody, or a demonstrated ability to learn the space quickly.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - US
jobs.description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the ET timezone in the US.

About the team

The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s AI products, including Research Flow, our platform for combining quantitative research with deeper qualitative insights.

We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

Through Research Flow, this includes helping customers design studies, run AI-moderated conversations with adaptive follow-up questions, and turn responses into useful insights.

The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable, and dependable customer experiences.

About the role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will be instrumental in building and evolving the AI capabilities behind Research Flow, alongside our broader AI products.

Your work will help customers understand the “why” behind responses and move from research questions to informed decisions faster.

Your scope will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership. You will turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers, with direct influence on their quality and performance. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

Things you will do

Build and deliver AI products

• Design, build, and deploy generative AI capabilities across Typeform’s products, with a key contribution to Research Flow.

• Develop applications using large language models, RAG, vector search, and agentic systems.

• Build services and APIs that allow product teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences.

• Turn prototypes into reliable production systems with clear measures of performance and quality.

• Explore new ways for customers to collect, understand, and act on information using AI.

Build scalable AI systems

• Design and operate machine learning services and workflows using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

• Build reliable pipelines for batch and real time processing using technologies such as Kafka and Airflow.

• Design solutions using vector databases to support retrieval, recommendations, personalisation, and semantic search.

• Use MLflow to manage experiments, model versions, registries, and deployments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our AI systems.

Evaluate and improve AI quality

• Build automated evaluation pipelines for generative AI applications, including the conversational and analytical capabilities behind Research Flow.

• Develop benchmarks that measure accuracy, relevance, reliability, fairness, latency, and cost.

• Evaluate retrieval strategies, including chunking, embeddings, context selection, and reranking.

• Monitor AI systems in production and identify opportunities to improve their quality and performance.

• Create safeguards that reduce unexpected behaviour and protect customer data.

Shape our AI engineering practice

• Establish reusable patterns and technical standards for building, evaluating, and releasing AI systems.

• Help teams make informed decisions about models, frameworks, infrastructure, performance, and cost.

• Apply strong engineering practices across testing, security, observability, version control, and deployment.

• Share technical knowledge and support the development of other engineers.

• Keep up with relevant AI research, tools, and engineering practices, applying what is useful to Typeform.

Collaborate across Typeform

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to connect AI investments with customer and business needs.

• Work with Data Scientists to turn experiments and models into reliable production services.

• Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical partners.

• Contribute to technical planning and help shape the direction of AI across Typeform.

What you bring

• At least four years of experience building and deploying machine learning or AI systems in production.

• Strong Python and software engineering skills.

• Experience building production services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI.

• Practical experience developing generative AI applications using large language models, RAG, tool use, or agentic systems.

• Experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.

• A strong understanding of enterprise RAG systems, including chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, evaluation, and monitoring.

• Experience creating automated evaluations for generative AI applications.

• Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and continuous integration and deployment practices.

• Experience using services such as AWS SageMaker or AWS Bedrock.

• Experience with Kafka, vector databases, or other technologies used for real time and high dimensional data processing.

• Experience managing machine learning workflows using MLflow.

• Experience monitoring production systems with tools such as Datadog or OpenSearch.

• The ability to balance quality, speed, reliability, scalability, and cost when making technical decisions.

• Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Data teams.

Extra awesome

• Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Argo Workflows.

• Familiarity with SQL, Spark, Snowflake, or other data processing technologies.

• Experience building systems that combine structured data, unstructured data, and generative AI.

• Experience with AI security, privacy, responsible AI, prompt injection protection, or data leakage prevention.

• Experience improving the latency and cost of AI systems operating at scale.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

• Establish patterns for retrieval, vector search, model orchestration, and working with structured and unstructured data.

• Build alignment around technical decisions through clear proposals, constructive discussion, and evidence.

Connect technical work to customer outcomes

• Contribute to planning across teams, making dependencies and sequencing clear.

• Help shape the broader direction of AI at Typeform through lessons learned from building and scaling Research Flow.

What you bring

• Significant experience building and operating machine learning or AI systems in production, with evidence of technical leadership beyond your own projects.

• A track record of leading complex engineering initiatives across teams, from ambiguous requirements to measurable production outcomes.

• Strong Python and software engineering skills, with the ability to contribute directly to production code.

• Experience designing production services and APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI.

• Practical experience building generative AI applications using large language models, RAG, tool use, or agentic systems.

• The ability to influence technical decisions across teams and build alignment without relying on formal authority.

• Experience mentoring engineers and improving the effectiveness of the teams around you.

Extra awesome

• Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

• Experience building conversational AI, adaptive interviewing, or automated analysis and summarisation systems.

• Experience working with text, audio, or video in AI applications.

• Experience evolving shared AI infrastructure or platforms used by multiple product teams.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Argo Workflows.

• Familiarity with SQL, Spark, Snowflake, or other data processing technologies.

• Experience with AI security, privacy, responsible AI, prompt injection protection, or data leakage prevention.

• Experience materially improving the latency, reliability, or cost of AI systems operating at scale.

No one likes a guessing game — that’s why we're transparent about the salary range for this role. In addition to the base, we offer a 5-10% bonus depending on your level and performance. jobs.title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Central Eastern Europe - Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands or London, United Kingdom

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Central Eastern Europe (CEE) Digital Natives Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.

What You'll Do

• Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.

• Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.

• Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.

• Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.

• Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Fluency in English and one of the languages from the CEE (written and spoken).

• 6+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions into Digital Natives companies across CEE, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.

• Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.

• Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.

• Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.

• Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).

• Bachelor's degree required, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.

• Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.

Compensation

• For Netherlands based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €144,000 - €198,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Onsite Recruitment Coordinator is responsible for providing client site support to the talent acquisition process lifecycle, from candidate attraction to post-hire activities. Additionally, the Onsite Recruitment Coordinator facilitates a variety of onsite logistical, relationship management, and customer service activities to service a client program or team.

Responsibilities:

As a Cielo Onsite Recruitment Coordinator supporting GE Vernova, you will be responsible for service excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. You will act as a brand ambassador, focusing on delivering exceptional talent while providing proactive and timely communication. This role supports high-volume production and logistics hiring within manufacturing environments.

• Work Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India
• Work Setup: 3 days onsite
• Language(s): Proven ability to manage stakeholder relationships and deliver recruitment activities, with working proficiency in Gujarati and English for daily business communication
• Work Hours: Standard working hours aligned with business needs

Duties and Responsibilities

• Cultivate and manage relationships with current and potential hiring leaders as an onsite representative.
• Manage candidate and client onsite communications and utilize client location knowledge and discretion to coordinate set-up of interview rooms, including materials distribution, and act as a recruitment contact during interview process.
• Meet and greet interviewers and candidates, including briefing candidates with a review of the role, interview format, and client details.
• Facilitate and grow professional relationships with local universities/colleges and technical programs as well as other resources to share client career paths and hiring needs.
• Assist in the creation of recruitment marketing plans specific to client location with local recruitment and candidate generation expertise.
• Act as liaison with the client to resolve daily operational issues.
• Showcase a high level of understanding and become fully engrained in the client organization including relationships with client stakeholders and organizational structure to further demonstrate “We Become You”.
• Provide professional recruitment resource for visitors, vendors, and candidates as necessary.
• Serve as a client representative through candidate attraction and engagement.
• Assist with onboarding processes, including new hire forms, new employee orientation presentations, etc., as well as offboarding processes.
• Act as a resource for client leaders, providing information and answering inquiries.
• Schedule phone, video and in-person interviews for Recruiters and Hiring Managers.
• Manage offer process, including creating and routing offer letters for approval.
• Coordinate background, drug, and reference checking processes.
• Arrange candidate travel, transportation, and accommodation.
• Edit and post positions to Applicant Tracking System (ATS) accurately and within the specified timeframe(s) with proper approval channels.
• Assist with and manage basic metrics reporting, as necessary.
• Provide other administrative support to recruiters, as needed.
• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Position Requirements

Education:

• High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred.

Experience:

• Minimum of 1-2 years proven experience in high-volume blue-collar recruitment within a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Exposure:

• Knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures within talent acquisition strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite, including Outlook, required.
• Exceptional communication and organizational skills.
• Ability to work in dynamic and constantly changing environment.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
The Junior Sous Chef - Chinese Cuisine plays an important role in maintaining the quality, consistency, and guest experience of the resort's Asian culinary operation.

The ideal candidate combines strong Chinese culinary knowledge, operational discipline, guest engagement, and the ability to support and develop the kitchen team while consistently maintaining the standards expected of a luxury resort.

• Support the Chef de Cuisine in the daily operation of the Chinese kitchen, ensuring all dishes are prepared and presented in accordance with established recipes, quality standards, and resort guidelines.
• Prepare and supervise authentic and contemporary Chinese cuisine, utilizing advanced Chinese cooking techniques including wok cooking, steaming, braising, roasting, grilling, frying, and the preparation of traditional sauces, stocks, noodles, rice dishes, and regional specialties.
• Assist in the planning and development of Chinese menus, seasonal promotions, themed dinners, private dining experiences, weddings, VIP functions, and special events.
• Supervise, train, coach, and develop junior culinary team members, ensuring adherence to culinary standards, food safety procedures, kitchen discipline, and operational excellence.
